            (forall y. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y))

name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_DISJOINT
display:
|- forall s s' t t'.
       DISJOINT s s' /\ DISJOINT t t'
       ==> (s =_c t /\ s' =_c t' <=>
            (exists f g.
                 (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN t /\ g (f x) = x) /\
                 (forall y. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y) /\
                 (forall x. x IN s' ==> f x IN t' /\ g (f x) = x) /\
                 (forall y. y IN t' ==> g y IN s' /\ f (g y) = y)))

name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_EXTEND
display:
|- forall f g s s' t t'.
       s SUBSET s' /\
       t SUBSET t' /\
       s' DIFF s =_c t' DIFF t /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN t /\ g (f x) = x) /\
       (forall y. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y)
       ==> (exists f' g'.
                (forall x. x IN s' ==> f' x IN t' /\ g' (f' x) = x) /\
                (forall y. y IN t' ==> g' y IN s' /\ f' (g' y) = y) /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> f' x = f x) /\
                (forall y. y IN t ==> g' y = g y))

name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_SUBSETS
display:
|- forall s s' t t'.
       s' SUBSET s /\ t' SUBSET t
       ==> (s' =_c t' /\ s DIFF s' =_c t DIFF t' <=>
            (exists f g.
                 (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN t /\ g (f x) = x) /\
                 (forall y. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y) /\
                 IMAGE f s' = t' /\
                 IMAGE g t' = s'))

        (exists w x y. P w x y /\ Q (f w x y))) /\

name: FINITE_SUBSET

name: FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE t /\ t SUBSET IMAGE f s <=>
       (exists s'. FINITE s' /\ s' SUBSET s /\ t = IMAGE f s')

name: FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE_IMP
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE t /\ t SUBSET IMAGE f s
       ==> (exists s'. FINITE s' /\ s' SUBSET s /\ t SUBSET IMAGE f s')

name: FINITE_SUBSET_NUMSEG

name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\ s SUBSET UNIONS f
       ==> (exists f'. FINITE f' /\ f' SUBSET f /\ s SUBSET UNIONS f')

name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       s SUBSET UNIONS f /\
       ~(f = {}) /\
       (forall t u. t IN f /\ u IN f ==> t SUBSET u \/ u SUBSET t)
       ==> (exists t. t IN f /\ s SUBSET t)

name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN_EQ
display:
|- forall f s.
       ~(f = {}) /\
       (forall t u. t IN f /\ u IN f ==> t SUBSET u \/ u SUBSET t) /\
       FINITE s
       ==> (s SUBSET UNIONS f <=> (exists t. t IN f /\ s SUBSET t))

name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_DIRECTED_EQ
display:
|- forall f s.
       ~(f = {}) /\
       (forall t u.
            t IN f /\ u IN f
            ==> (exists v. v IN f /\ t SUBSET v /\ u SUBSET v)) /\
       FINITE s
       ==> (s SUBSET UNIONS f <=> (exists t. t IN f /\ s SUBSET t))

name: FINITE_SUM_IMAGE

name: FINITE_SUPPORT

name: FINITE_SUPPORT_DELTA

name: FINITE_TRANSITIVITY_CHAIN

       (forall x. ~R x x) /\
       (forall x y z. R x y /\ R y z ==> R x z) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> (exists y. y IN s /\ R x y))
       ==> s = {}

name: FINITE_UNION

name: FINITE_UNIONS

name: FINITE_UNION_IMP
display: |- forall s t. FINITE s /\ FINITE t ==> FINITE (s UNION t)

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_EMPTY

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
display: |- forall P. FINITE UNION_OF FINITE UNION_OF P = FINITE UNION_OF P

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INC

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER

       (forall s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s INTER t))
       ==> (forall s t.
                (FINITE UNION_OF P) s /\ (FINITE UNION_OF P) t
                ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall s t.
            (FINITE UNION_OF P) s /\ (FINITE UNION_OF P) t
            ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t)) <=>
       (forall s t. P s /\ P t ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNION
display:
|- forall P s t.
       (FINITE UNION_OF P) s /\ (FINITE UNION_OF P) t
       ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s UNION t)

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNIONS
display:

name: FINITE_UNIV_PAIR

name: FINREC
display:
|- (FINREC f b s a 0 <=> s = {} /\ a = b) /\
   (FINREC f b s a (SUC n) <=>
    (exists x c. x IN s /\ FINREC f b (s DELETE x) c n /\ a = f x c))

name: FINREC_1_LEMMA
display:
|- forall f b s a.
       FINREC f b s a (SUC 0) <=> (exists x. s = {x} /\ a = f x b)

name: FINREC_EXISTS_LEMMA
display: |- forall f b s. FINITE s ==> (exists a n. FINREC f b s a n)

name: FINREC_FUN
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> (exists g.
                g {} = b /\
                (forall s x.
                     FINITE s /\ x IN s ==> g s = f x (g (s DELETE x))))

name: FINREC_FUN_LEMMA
display:
|- forall P R.
       (forall s. P s ==> (exists a n. R s a n)) /\
       (forall n1 n2 s a1 a2. R s a1 n1 /\ R s a2 n2 ==> a1 = a2 /\ n1 = n2)
       ==> (exists f. forall s a. P s ==> ((exists n. R s a n) <=> f s = a))

name: FINREC_SUC_LEMMA
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> (forall n s z.
                FINREC f b s z (SUC n)
                ==> (forall x.
                         x IN s
                         ==> (exists w.
                                  FINREC f b (s DELETE x) w n /\ z = f x w)))

name: FINREC_UNIQUE_LEMMA
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> (forall n1 n2 s a1 a2.
                FINREC f b s a1 n1 /\ FINREC f b s a2 n2
                ==> a1 = a2 /\ n1 = n2)

name: GCD

|- forall a b.
       (gcd (a,b) divides a /\ gcd (a,b) divides b) /\
       (forall e. e divides a /\ e divides b ==> e divides gcd (a,b))

name: GCD_0

name: GCD_1

name: GCD_2_CASES

name: GCD_ADD

   (forall a b. gcd (b + a,b) = gcd (a,b)) /\
   (forall a b. gcd (a,a + b) = gcd (a,b)) /\
   (forall a b. gcd (a,b + a) = gcd (a,b))

name: GCD_ASSOC

name: GCD_BEZOUT
display:

       (exists x y. a * x - b * y = d \/ b * x - a * y = d) <=>

name: GCD_BEZOUT_SUM
display: |- forall a b d x y. a * x + b * y = d ==> gcd (a,b) divides d

name: GCD_COPRIME

|- forall a b a' b'.
       ~(gcd (a,b) = 0) /\ a = a' * gcd (a,b) /\ b = b' * gcd (a,b)
       ==> coprime (a',b')

name: GCD_COPRIME_DIVIDES_LMUL

       coprime (a,b) /\ a divides c ==> gcd (a * b,c) = a * gcd (b,c)

name: GCD_COPRIME_DIVIDES_RMUL
display:

       coprime (b,c) /\ b divides a ==> gcd (a,b * c) = b * gcd (a,c)

name: GCD_COPRIME_EXISTS
display:
|- forall a b.
       exists a' b'.
           a = a' * gcd (a,b) /\ b = b' * gcd (a,b) /\ coprime (a',b')

name: GCD_COPRIME_LMUL
display: |- forall a b c. coprime (a,b) ==> gcd (a * b,c) = gcd (a,c) * gcd (b,c)

name: GCD_COPRIME_RMUL
display: |- forall a b c. coprime (a,b) ==> gcd (c,a * b) = gcd (c,a) * gcd (c,b)

name: GCD_EQ
display:
|- (forall d. d divides x /\ d divides y <=> d divides u /\ d divides v)
   ==> gcd (x,y) = gcd (u,v)

name: GCD_EXP
display: |- forall n a b. gcd (a EXP n,b EXP n) = gcd (a,b) EXP n

name: GCD_LCM_DISTRIB
display: |- forall a b c. gcd (a,lcm (b,c)) = lcm (gcd (a,b),gcd (a,c))

name: GCD_LE
display:
|- (forall m n. gcd (m,n) <= m <=> m = 0 ==> n = 0) /\
   (forall m n. gcd (m,n) <= n <=> n = 0 ==> m = 0)

name: GCD_LE_MAX
display: |- forall m n. gcd (m,n) <= MAX m n

name: GCD_LE_MIN
display: |- forall m n. (m = 0 <=> n = 0) ==> gcd (m,n) <= MIN m n

name: GCD_LE_MIN_EQ
display: |- forall m n. gcd (m,n) <= MIN m n <=> m = 0 <=> n = 0

name: GCD_LMUL
display: |- forall a b c. gcd (c * a,c * b) = c * gcd (a,b)

name: GCD_MULTIPLE
display: |- forall a b. gcd (b,a * b) = b

name: GCD_MUL_COPRIME
display:
|- (forall a b c. coprime (a,b) ==> gcd (a,b * c) = gcd (a,c)) /\
   (forall a b c. coprime (a,c) ==> gcd (a,b * c) = gcd (a,b)) /\
   (forall a b c. coprime (b,c) ==> gcd (a,b * c) = gcd (a,b) * gcd (a,c)) /\
   (forall a b c. coprime (a,c) ==> gcd (a * b,c) = gcd (b,c)) /\
   (forall a b c. coprime (b,c) ==> gcd (a * b,c) = gcd (a,c)) /\
   (forall a b c. coprime (a,b) ==> gcd (a * b,c) = gcd (a,c) * gcd (b,c))

name: GCD_ONE
display: |- forall a b. coprime (a,b) ==> gcd (a,b) = 1

name: GCD_PRIME_CASES
display:
|- (forall p n. prime p ==> gcd (p,n) = (if p divides n then p else 1)) /\
   (forall p n. prime p ==> gcd (n,p) = (if p divides n then p else 1))

name: GCD_REFL
display: |- forall a. gcd (a,a) = a

name: GCD_RMUL
display: |- forall a b c. gcd (a * c,b * c) = c * gcd (a,b)

name: GCD_SUB
display:
|- (forall a b. b <= a ==> gcd (a - b,b) = gcd (a,b)) /\
   (forall a b. a <= b ==> gcd (a,b - a) = gcd (a,b))

name: GCD_SYM
display: |- forall a b. gcd (a,b) = gcd (b,a)

name: GCD_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall d a b.
       (d divides a /\ d divides b) /\
       (forall e. e divides a /\ e divides b ==> e divides d) <=>
       d = gcd (a,b)

name: GCD_ZERO
display: |- forall a b. gcd (a,b) = 0 <=> a = 0 /\ b = 0

name: GE

name: GEQ_DEF
display: |- forall a b. GEQ a b <=> a = b

name: GE_C

name: GSPEC

name: GT

name: HALF_DOUBLE
display: |- (forall n. (2 * n) DIV 2 = n) /\ (forall n. (n * 2) DIV 2 = n)

name: HAS_INF
display:
|- forall s l.
       s has_inf l <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> l <= x) /\
       (forall c. l < c ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ x < c))

name: HAS_INF_APPROACH
display: |- forall s l c. s has_inf l /\ l < c ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ x < c)

name: HAS_INF_INF
display:
|- forall s l.
       s has_inf l <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x) /\ inf s = l

name: HAS_INF_LBOUND
display: |- forall s b x. s has_inf b /\ x IN s ==> b <= x

name: HAS_INF_LE
display:
|- forall s t l m.
       s has_inf l /\
       t has_inf m /\
       (forall y. y IN t ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ x <= y))
       ==> l <= m

name: HAS_SIZE
display: |- forall s n. s HAS_SIZE n <=> FINITE s /\ CARD s = n

name: HAS_SIZE_0
display: |- forall s. s HAS_SIZE 0 <=> s = {}

name: HAS_SIZE_1

name: HAS_SIZE_2

name: HAS_SIZE_4
display: |- (:4) HAS_SIZE 4

name: HAS_SIZE_BOOL

name: HAS_SIZE_CARD
display: |- forall s n. s HAS_SIZE n ==> CARD s = n

name: HAS_SIZE_CART
display:
|- forall P m.
       (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> {x | P i x} HAS_SIZE m i)
       ==> {v | forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> P i (v$i)} HAS_SIZE
           nproduct (1..dimindex (:N)) m

name: HAS_SIZE_CART_UNIV
display: |- forall m. (:A) HAS_SIZE m ==> (:A^N) HAS_SIZE m EXP dimindex (:N)

name: HAS_SIZE_CLAUSES
display:
|- (s HAS_SIZE 0 <=> s = {}) /\
   (s HAS_SIZE SUC n <=>
    (exists a t. t HAS_SIZE n /\ ~(a IN t) /\ s = a INSERT t))

name: HAS_SIZE_CROSS
display: |- forall s t m n. s HAS_SIZE m /\ t HAS_SIZE n ==> s CROSS t HAS_SIZE m * n

name: HAS_SIZE_DIFF
display:
|- forall s t m n.
       s HAS_SIZE m /\ t HAS_SIZE n /\ t SUBSET s ==> s DIFF t HAS_SIZE m - n

name: HAS_SIZE_FINITE_IMAGE
display: |- forall s. (:(A)finite_image) HAS_SIZE dimindex s

name: HAS_SIZE_FUNSPACE
display:
|- forall d n t m s.
       s HAS_SIZE m /\ t HAS_SIZE n
       ==> {f | (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\
                (forall x. ~(x IN s) ==> f x = d)} HAS_SIZE
           n EXP m

name: HAS_SIZE_FUNSPACE_UNIV
display:
|- forall m n.
       (:A) HAS_SIZE m /\ (:B) HAS_SIZE n ==> (:A->B) HAS_SIZE n EXP m

name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ
display:
|- forall f s n.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\ s HAS_SIZE n
       ==> IMAGE f s HAS_SIZE n

name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
display:
|- forall f s n.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> (IMAGE f s HAS_SIZE n <=> s HAS_SIZE n)

name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ_RESTRICT
display:
|- forall f s t P n.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       CARD s = CARD t /\
       IMAGE f s SUBSET t /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
       {x | x IN s /\ P (f x)} HAS_SIZE n
       ==> {x | x IN t /\ P x} HAS_SIZE n

name: HAS_SIZE_INDEX
display:
|- forall s n.
       s HAS_SIZE n
       ==> (exists f.
                (forall m. m < n ==> f m IN s) /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> (existsunique m. m < n /\ f m = x)))

name: HAS_SIZE_INTSEG_INT
display:
|- forall a b.
       integer a /\ integer b
       ==> {x | integer x /\ a <= x /\ x <= b} HAS_SIZE
           (if b < a then 0 else num_of_int (int_of_real (b - a + &1)))

name: HAS_SIZE_INTSEG_NUM
display: |- forall m n. {x | integer x /\ &m <= x /\ x <= &n} HAS_SIZE (n + 1) - m

name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG
display: |- forall m n. m..n HAS_SIZE (n + 1) - m

name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_1
display: |- forall n. 1..n HAS_SIZE n

name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_LE
display: |- forall n. {m | m <= n} HAS_SIZE n + 1

name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_LT
display: |- forall n. {m | m < n} HAS_SIZE n

name: HAS_SIZE_PCROSS
display: |- forall s t m n. s HAS_SIZE m /\ t HAS_SIZE n ==> s PCROSS t HAS_SIZE m * n

name: HAS_SIZE_POWERSET
display: |- forall s n. s HAS_SIZE n ==> {t | t SUBSET s} HAS_SIZE 2 EXP n

name: HAS_SIZE_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall s m t n.
       s HAS_SIZE m /\ t HAS_SIZE n
       ==> {x,y | x IN s /\ y IN t} HAS_SIZE m * n

name: HAS_SIZE_PRODUCT_DEPENDENT
display:
|- forall s m t n.
       s HAS_SIZE m /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> t x HAS_SIZE n)
       ==> {x,y | x IN s /\ y IN t x} HAS_SIZE m * n

name: HAS_SIZE_RESTRICTED_POWERSET
display:
|- forall n m s.
       s HAS_SIZE n ==> {t | t SUBSET s /\ t HAS_SIZE m} HAS_SIZE binom (n,m)

name: HAS_SIZE_SET_OF_LIST
display: |- forall l. set_of_list l HAS_SIZE LENGTH l <=> PAIRWISE (\x y. ~(x = y)) l

name: HAS_SIZE_SUC
display:
|- forall s n.
       s HAS_SIZE SUC n <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\ (forall a. a IN s ==> s DELETE a HAS_SIZE n)

name: HAS_SIZE_TYBIT0
display: |- (:(A)tybit0) HAS_SIZE 2 * dimindex (:A)

name: HAS_SIZE_TYBIT1
display: |- (:(A)tybit1) HAS_SIZE 2 * dimindex (:A) + 1

name: HAS_SIZE_UNION
display:
|- forall s t m n.
       s HAS_SIZE m /\ t HAS_SIZE n /\ DISJOINT s t
       ==> s UNION t HAS_SIZE m + n

name: HAS_SIZE_UNIONS
display:
|- forall s t m n.
       s HAS_SIZE m /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> t x HAS_SIZE n) /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) ==> DISJOINT (t x) (t y))
       ==> UNIONS {t x | x IN s} HAS_SIZE m * n

name: HAS_SUP
display:
|- forall s l.
       s has_sup l <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= l) /\
       (forall c. c < l ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ c < x))

name: HAS_SUP_APPROACH
display: |- forall s l c. s has_sup l /\ c < l ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ c < x)

name: HAS_SUP_LE
display:
|- forall s t l m.

name: HAS_SUP_SUP
display:
|- forall s l.

       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) /\ sup s = l

name: HAS_SUP_UBOUND
display: |- forall s b x. s has_sup b /\ x IN s ==> x <= b

name: HD

name: HREAL_ADD_RID

name: HREAL_ADD_SYM

name: HREAL_ARCH

name: HREAL_EQ_ADD_LCANCEL
display: |- forall m n p. hreal_add m n = hreal_add m p <=> n = p

name: HREAL_EQ_ADD_RCANCEL
display: |- forall m n p. hreal_add m p = hreal_add n p <=> m = n

name: HREAL_LE_ADD

name: HREAL_LE_ADD_LCANCEL
display: |- forall m n p. hreal_le (hreal_add m n) (hreal_add m p) <=> hreal_le n p

name: HREAL_LE_ADD_RCANCEL
display: |- forall m n p. hreal_le (hreal_add m p) (hreal_add n p) <=> hreal_le m n

name: HREAL_LE_ANTISYM

name: HREAL_LE_EXISTS

name: HREAL_LE_TOTAL

name: HREAL_LE_TRANS
display: |- forall x y z. hreal_le x y /\ hreal_le y z ==> hreal_le x z

name: HREAL_MUL_ASSOC
display: |- forall x y z. hreal_mul x (hreal_mul y z) = hreal_mul (hreal_mul x y) z

name: HREAL_MUL_LID

name: HREAL_MUL_RZERO

name: HREAL_MUL_SYM

name: IMAGE
display: |- forall s f. IMAGE f s = {y | exists x. x IN s /\ y = f x}

name: IMAGE_CLAUSES
display: |- IMAGE f {} = {} /\ IMAGE f (x INSERT s) = f x INSERT IMAGE f s

name: IMAGE_CONST
display: |- forall s c. IMAGE (\x. c) s = (if s = {} then {} else {c})

name: IMAGE_DELETE_INJ
display:
|- forall f s a.
       (forall x. x IN s /\ f x = f a ==> x = a)
       ==> IMAGE f (s DELETE a) = IMAGE f s DELETE f a

name: IMAGE_DELETE_INJ_ALT
display:
|- forall f s a.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\ a IN s
       ==> IMAGE f (s DELETE a) = IMAGE f s DELETE f a

name: IMAGE_DIFF_INJ
display:
|- forall f s t.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN t /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> IMAGE f (s DIFF t) = IMAGE f s DIFF IMAGE f t

name: IMAGE_DIFF_INJ_ALT
display:
|- forall f s t.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\ t SUBSET s
       ==> IMAGE f (s DIFF t) = IMAGE f s DIFF IMAGE f t

name: IMAGE_EQ
display: |- forall f g s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x) ==> IMAGE f s = IMAGE g s

name: IMAGE_EQ_EMPTY
display: |- forall f s. IMAGE f s = {} <=> s = {}

name: IMAGE_FSTCART_PCROSS
display: |- forall s t. IMAGE fstcart (s PCROSS t) = (if t = {} then {} else s)

name: IMAGE_FST_CROSS
display: |- forall s t. IMAGE FST (s CROSS t) = (if t = {} then {} else s)

name: IMAGE_I
display: |- forall s. IMAGE I s = s

name: IMAGE_ID
display: |- forall s. IMAGE (\x. x) s = s

name: IMAGE_IMP_INJECTIVE
display:
|- forall s f.
       FINITE s /\ IMAGE f s = s
       ==> (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: IMAGE_IMP_INJECTIVE_GEN
display:
|- forall s t f.
       FINITE s /\ CARD s = CARD t /\ IMAGE f s = t
       ==> (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: IMAGE_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_OF_SUBSET
display:
|- forall f s.
       exists t.
           t SUBSET s /\
           IMAGE f s = IMAGE f t /\
           (forall x y. x IN t /\ y IN t /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: IMAGE_INTERS
display:
|- forall f s.
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x y. x IN UNIONS s /\ y IN UNIONS s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> IMAGE f (INTERS s) = INTERS (IMAGE (IMAGE f) s)

name: IMAGE_INTERS_SATURATED
display:
|- forall f g s.
       ~(g = {}) /\
       (forall t. t IN g DELETE s ==> {x | f x IN IMAGE f t} SUBSET t)
       ==> IMAGE f (INTERS g) = INTERS (IMAGE (IMAGE f) g)

name: IMAGE_INTERS_SATURATED_GEN
display:
|- forall f g s u.
       ~(g = {}) /\
       (forall t. t IN g ==> t SUBSET u) /\
       (forall t.
            t IN g DELETE s ==> {x | x IN u /\ f x IN IMAGE f t} SUBSET t)
       ==> IMAGE f (INTERS g) = INTERS (IMAGE (IMAGE f) g)

name: IMAGE_INTERS_SUBSET
display: |- forall f g. IMAGE f (INTERS g) SUBSET INTERS (IMAGE (IMAGE f) g)

name: IMAGE_INTER_INJ
display:
|- forall f s t.
       (forall x y. f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> IMAGE f (s INTER t) = IMAGE f s INTER IMAGE f t

name: IMAGE_INTER_SATURATED
display:
|- forall f s t.
       {x | f x IN IMAGE f s} SUBSET s \/ {x | f x IN IMAGE f t} SUBSET t
       ==> IMAGE f (s INTER t) = IMAGE f s INTER IMAGE f t

name: IMAGE_INTER_SATURATED_GEN
display:
|- forall f s t u.
       {x | x IN u /\ f x IN IMAGE f s} SUBSET s /\ t SUBSET u \/
       {x | x IN u /\ f x IN IMAGE f t} SUBSET t /\ s SUBSET u
       ==> IMAGE f (s INTER t) = IMAGE f s INTER IMAGE f t

name: IMAGE_INTER_SUBSET
display: |- forall f s t. IMAGE f (s INTER t) SUBSET IMAGE f s INTER IMAGE f t

name: IMAGE_PAIRED_CROSS
display:
|- forall f g s t.
       IMAGE (\(x,y). f x,g y) (s CROSS t) = IMAGE f s CROSS IMAGE g t

name: IMAGE_PRODUCT_MAP
display:
|- forall f k s.
       IMAGE (product_map k f) (cartesian_product k s) =
       cartesian_product k (\i. IMAGE (f i) (s i))

name: IMAGE_RESTRICTION

name: IMAGE_SNDCART_PCROSS
display: |- forall s t. IMAGE sndcart (s PCROSS t) = (if s = {} then {} else t)

name: IMAGE_SND_CROSS
display: |- forall s t. IMAGE SND (s CROSS t) = (if s = {} then {} else t)

name: IMAGE_UNION

name: IMAGE_o

name: IMP_CLAUSES
display:
|- forall t.
       (true ==> t <=> t) /\
       (t ==> true <=> true) /\
       (false ==> t <=> true) /\
       (t ==> t <=> true) /\
       (t ==> false <=> ~t)

name: IN

name: INDEX_0
display: |- forall p. index p 0 = 0

name: INDEX_1
display: |- forall p. index p 1 = 0

name: INDEX_ADD
display:
|- forall p n m.
       ~(n = 0) /\ (~(m = 0) ==> index p n < index p m)
       ==> index p (m + n) = index p n

name: INDEX_ADD_MIN
display: |- forall p m n. MIN (index p m) (index p n) <= index p (m + n)

name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION
display:
|- forall n p.
       exists m.
           p EXP index p n * m = n /\ (n = 0 \/ p = 1 \/ ~(p divides m))

name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_LE
display:
|- forall p e1 m1 e2 m2.
       p EXP e1 * m1 = p EXP e2 * m2 /\ ~(p = 0) /\ ~(p divides m2)
       ==> e1 <= e2

name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_PRIME
display:
|- forall n p.
       prime p
       ==> (exists m. p EXP index p n * m = n /\ (n = 0 \/ coprime (p,m)))

name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall p e1 m1 e2 m2.
       p EXP e1 * m1 = p EXP e2 * m2 /\
       ~(p = 0) /\
       ~(p divides m1) /\
       ~(p divides m2)
       ==> e1 = e2

name: INDEX_EQ_0
display: |- forall p n. index p n = 0 <=> n = 0 \/ p = 1 \/ ~(p divides n)

name: INDEX_EXP
display: |- forall p n k. prime p ==> index p (n EXP k) = k * index p n

name: INDEX_FACT
display: |- forall p n. prime p ==> index p (FACT n) = nsum (1..n) (\m. index p m)

name: INDEX_FACT_ALT
display:
|- forall p n.
       prime p
       ==> index p (FACT n) =
           nsum {j | 1 <= j /\ p EXP j <= n} (\j. n DIV p EXP j)

name: INDEX_FACT_PRIME_MULT
display: |- forall p n. prime p ==> index p (FACT (p * n)) = n + index p (FACT n)

name: INDEX_FACT_UNBOUNDED
display:
|- forall p n.
       prime p ==> index p (FACT n) = nsum {j | 1 <= j} (\j. n DIV p EXP j)

name: INDEX_GCD
display:
|- forall m n p.
       prime p
       ==> index p (gcd (m,n)) =
           (if m = 0
            then index p n
            else if n = 0 then index p m else MIN (index p m) (index p n))

name: INDEX_LCM
display:
|- forall m n p.
       prime p
       ==> index p (lcm (m,n)) =
           (if m = 0 \/ n = 0 then 0 else MAX (index p m) (index p n))

name: INDEX_LT
display: |- forall n p k. (~(n = 0) \/ ~(k = 0)) /\ n < p EXP k ==> index p n < k

name: INDEX_MUL
display:
|- forall m n.
       prime p /\ ~(m = 0) /\ ~(n = 0)
       ==> index p (m * n) = index p m + index p n

name: INDEX_MULT_ADD
display:
|- (forall p m n k.
        ~(n = 0) /\ index p n < k ==> index p (p EXP k * m + n) = index p n) /\
   (forall p m n k.
        ~(n = 0) /\ index p n < k ==> index p (m * p EXP k + n) = index p n) /\
   (forall p m n k.
        ~(n = 0) /\ index p n < k ==> index p (n + m * p EXP k) = index p n) /\
   (forall p m n k.
        ~(n = 0) /\ index p n < k ==> index p (n + p EXP k * m) = index p n)

name: INDEX_MULT_BASE
display:
|- (forall p n.
        index p (p * n) = (if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else index p n + 1)) /\
   (forall p n.
        index p (n * p) = (if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else index p n + 1))

name: INDEX_MULT_EXP
display:
|- (forall p n k.
        index p (p EXP k * n) =
        (if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else k + index p n)) /\
   (forall p n k.
        index p (n * p EXP k) =
        (if n = 0 \/ p <= 1 then 0 else index p n + k))

name: INDEX_NSUM_LE
display:
|- forall f p n k.
       FINITE k /\ ~(k = {}) /\ (forall a. a IN k ==> n <= index p (f a))
       ==> n <= index p (nsum k f)

name: INDEX_POW
display: |- forall p n k. index (p EXP k) n = index p n DIV k

name: INDEX_PRIME
display: |- forall p a. prime p ==> index a p = (if p = a then 1 else 0)

name: INDEX_REFL
display: |- forall n. index n n = (if n <= 1 then 0 else 1)

name: INDEX_SUB_MIN
display: |- forall p m n. n < m ==> MIN (index p m) (index p n) <= index p (m - n)

name: INDEX_TRIVIAL_BOUND
display: |- forall n p. index p n <= n

name: INDEX_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall p m n e.
       p EXP e * m = n /\ (p = 0 ==> e = 0) /\ ~(p divides m)
       ==> index p n = e

name: INDEX_UNIQUE_ALT
display:
|- forall n p k.
       index p n = k <=>
       (if p = 1 \/ n = 0
        then k = 0
        else p EXP k divides n /\ ~(p EXP (k + 1) divides n))

name: INDEX_UNIQUE_EQ
display:
|- forall n p k.
       index p n = k <=>
       (if p = 1 \/ n = 0
        then k = 0
        else forall j. p EXP j divides n <=> j <= k)

name: INDEX_ZERO
display: |- forall p n. ~(p divides n) ==> index p n = 0

name: INDUCT_COPRIME
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall a b.
            1 < a /\ 1 < b /\ coprime (a,b) /\ P a /\ P b ==> P (a * b)) /\
       (forall p k. prime p ==> P (p EXP k))
       ==> (forall n. 1 < n ==> P n)

name: INDUCT_COPRIME_ALT
display:
|- forall P.
       P 0 /\
       (forall a b.
            1 < a /\ 1 < b /\ coprime (a,b) /\ P a /\ P b ==> P (a * b)) /\
       (forall p k. prime p ==> P (p EXP k))
       ==> (forall n. P n)

name: INDUCT_COPRIME_STRONG
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall a b.
            1 < a /\ 1 < b /\ coprime (a,b) /\ P a /\ P b ==> P (a * b)) /\
       (forall p k. prime p /\ ~(k = 0) ==> P (p EXP k))
       ==> (forall n. 1 < n ==> P n)

name: IND_SUC_0
display: |- forall x. ~(IND_SUC x = IND_0)

name: IND_SUC_0_EXISTS
display:
|- exists f z.
       (forall x1 x2. f x1 = f x2 <=> x1 = x2) /\ (forall x. ~(f x = z))

name: IND_SUC_INJ
display: |- forall x1 x2. IND_SUC x1 = IND_SUC x2 <=> x1 = x2

name: IND_SUC_SPEC
display:
|- (forall x1 x2. IND_SUC x1 = IND_SUC x2 <=> x1 = x2) /\
   (forall x. ~(IND_SUC x = IND_0))

name: INF
display:
|- forall s.
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x)
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> inf s <= x) /\
           (forall b. (forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x) ==> b <= inf s)

name: INFINITE
display: |- forall s. INFINITE s <=> ~FINITE s

name: INFINITE_CARD_LE
display: |- forall s. INFINITE s <=> (:num) <=_c s

name: INFINITE_CROSS_EQ
display:
|- forall s t.
       INFINITE (s CROSS t) <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\ INFINITE t \/ INFINITE s /\ ~(t = {})

name: INFINITE_CROSS_UNIV
display: |- INFINITE (:A#B) <=> INFINITE (:A) \/ INFINITE (:B)

name: INFINITE_DIFF_FINITE
display: |- forall s t. INFINITE s /\ FINITE t ==> INFINITE (s DIFF t)

name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE
display:
|- forall s.
       INFINITE s
       ==> (exists r.
                (forall m n. m < n ==> r m < r n) /\ IMAGE r (:num) = s)

name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_EQ
display:
|- forall s.
       INFINITE s <=>
       (exists r. (forall m n. m < n ==> r m < r n) /\ IMAGE r (:num) = s)

name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_SUBSET
display:
|- forall s.
       INFINITE s <=>
       (exists f. (forall x. f x IN s) /\ (forall x y. f x = f y ==> x = y))

name: INFINITE_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f s.
       INFINITE s /\ (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> INFINITE (IMAGE f s)

name: INFINITE_IMAGE_INJ
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall x y. f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> (forall s. INFINITE s ==> INFINITE (IMAGE f s))

name: INFINITE_INTEGER
display: |- INFINITE integer

name: INFINITE_NONEMPTY
display: |- forall s. INFINITE s ==> ~(s = {})

name: INFINITE_RATIONAL
display: |- INFINITE rational

name: INFINITE_RATIONAL_IN_RANGE
display: |- forall a b. a < b ==> INFINITE {q | rational q /\ a < q /\ q < b}

name: INFINITE_SUPERSET
display: |- forall s t. INFINITE s /\ s SUBSET t ==> INFINITE t

name: INFINITE_UNIV_PAIR
display: |- INFINITE (:A#A) <=> INFINITE (:A)

name: INFINITY_AX
display: |- exists f. ONE_ONE f /\ ~ONTO f

name: INF_APPROACH
display:
|- forall s c.
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x) /\ inf s < c
       ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ x < c)

name: INF_EQ
display:
|- forall s t.
       (forall a.
            (forall x. x IN s ==> a <= x) <=> (forall x. x IN t ==> a <= x))
       ==> inf s = inf t

name: INF_EXISTS
display:
|- forall s.
       (exists l. s has_inf l) <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x)

name: INF_FINITE
display:
|- forall s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})
       ==> inf s IN s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> inf s <= x)

name: INF_FINITE_LEMMA
display:
|- forall s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})
       ==> (exists b. b IN s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x))

name: INF_INSERT_FINITE
display:
|- forall x s.
       FINITE s ==> inf (x INSERT s) = (if s = {} then x else min x (inf s))

name: INF_INSERT_INSERT
display: |- forall a b s. inf (b INSERT a INSERT s) = inf (min a b INSERT s)

name: INF_LE_ELEMENT
display:
|- forall s a.
       (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x) /\ a IN s ==> inf s <= a

name: INF_SING
display: |- forall a. inf {a} = a

name: INF_UNION
display:
|- forall s t.
       ~(s = {}) /\
       ~(t = {}) /\
       (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> b <= x) /\
       (exists c. forall x. x IN t ==> c <= x)
       ==> inf (s UNION t) = min (inf s) (inf t)

name: INF_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall s b.
       (forall c. (forall x. x IN s ==> c <= x) <=> c <= b) ==> inf s = b

name: INF_UNIQUE_FINITE
display:
|- forall s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})
       ==> (inf s = a <=> a IN s /\ (forall y. y IN s ==> a <= y))

name: INJ
display:
|- forall t s f.
       INJ f s t <=>
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: INJA
display: |- forall a. INJA a = (\n b. b = a)

name: INJA_INJ
display: |- forall a1 a2. INJA a1 = INJA a2 <=> a1 = a2

name: INJECTIVE_ALT
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall x y. f x = f y ==> x = y) <=>
       (forall x y. f x = f y <=> x = y)

name: INJECTIVE_EXP_MODULO
display:
|- forall n a b k.
       coprime (k,phi n) /\
       coprime (n,a) /\
       coprime (n,b) /\
       (a EXP k == b EXP k) (mod n)
       ==> (a == b) (mod n)

name: INJECTIVE_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall s t. IMAGE f s = IMAGE f t ==> s = t) <=>
       (forall x y. f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall x y. f x = f y ==> x = y) <=>
       (exists g. forall x. g (f x) = x)

name: INJECTIVE_MAP
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall l m. MAP f l = MAP f m ==> l = m) <=>
       (forall x y. f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: INJECTIVE_ON_ALT
display:
|- forall P f.
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) <=>
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y))

name: INJECTIVE_ON_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f u.
       (forall s t.
            s SUBSET u /\ t SUBSET u /\ IMAGE f s = IMAGE f t ==> s = t) <=>
       (forall x y. x IN u /\ y IN u /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: INJECTIVE_ON_LEFT_INVERSE
display:
|- forall f s.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) <=>
       (exists g. forall x. x IN s ==> g (f x) = x)

name: INJECTIVE_ON_PREIMAGE
display:
|- forall f s u.
       (forall t t'.
            t SUBSET u /\
            t' SUBSET u /\
            {x | x IN s /\ f x IN t} = {x | x IN s /\ f x IN t'}
            ==> t = t') <=>
       u SUBSET IMAGE f s

name: INJECTIVE_PREIMAGE
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall t t'. {x | f x IN t} = {x | f x IN t'} ==> t = t') <=>
       IMAGE f (:A) = (:B)

name: INJF
display: |- forall f. INJF f = (\n. f (NUMFST n) (NUMSND n))

name: INJF_INJ
display: |- forall f1 f2. INJF f1 = INJF f2 <=> f1 = f2

name: INJN
display: |- forall m. INJN m = (\n a. n = m)

name: INJN_INJ
display: |- forall n1 n2. INJN n1 = INJN n2 <=> n1 = n2

name: INJP
display:
|- forall f1 f2.
       INJP f1 f2 =
       (\n a. if NUMLEFT n then f1 (NUMRIGHT n) a else f2 (NUMRIGHT n) a)

name: INJP_INJ
display: |- forall f1 f1' f2 f2'. INJP f1 f2 = INJP f1' f2' <=> f1 = f1' /\ f2 = f2'

name: INJ_INVERSE2
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall x1 y1 x2 y2. P x1 y1 = P x2 y2 <=> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2)
       ==> (exists X Y. forall x y. X (P x y) = x /\ Y (P x y) = y)

name: INSEG_ANTISYM
display: |- forall l m. l inseg m /\ m inseg l ==> l = m

name: INSEG_FLD_SUBSET
display: |- forall l m. l inseg m ==> fld l SUBSET fld m

name: INSEG_LINSEG
display:
|- forall l m.
       woset l
       ==> (m inseg l <=> m = l \/ (exists a. fld l a /\ m = linseg l a))

name: INSEG_ORDINAL
display: |- forall l m. m inseg l /\ ordinal l ==> ordinal m

name: INSEG_PROPER_SUBSET
display: |- forall l m. m inseg l /\ ~(l = m) ==> (exists x y. l x y /\ ~m x y)

name: INSEG_PROPER_SUBSET_FLD
display: |- forall l m. m inseg l /\ ~(l = m) ==> (exists a. fld l a /\ ~fld m a)

name: INSEG_REFL
display: |- forall l. l inseg l

name: INSEG_SUBSET
display: |- forall l m. m inseg l ==> (forall x y. m x y ==> l x y)

name: INSEG_SUBSET_FLD
display: |- forall l m. m inseg l ==> (forall x. fld m x ==> fld l x)

name: INSEG_TRANS
display: |- forall l m n. l inseg m /\ m inseg n ==> l inseg n

name: INSEG_WOSET
display: |- forall l m. m inseg l /\ woset l ==> woset m

name: INSERT
display: |- x INSERT s = {y | y IN s \/ y = x}

name: INSERT_AC
display:
|- x INSERT y INSERT s = y INSERT x INSERT s /\
   x INSERT x INSERT s = x INSERT s

name: INSERT_COMM
display: |- forall x y s. x INSERT y INSERT s = y INSERT x INSERT s

name: INSERT_DEF
display: |- forall s x. x INSERT s = (\y. y IN s \/ y = x)

name: INSERT_DELETE
display: |- forall x s. x IN s ==> x INSERT (s DELETE x) = s

name: INSERT_DIFF
display:
|- forall s t x.
       x INSERT s DIFF t = (if x IN t then s DIFF t else x INSERT (s DIFF t))

name: INSERT_INSERT
display: |- forall x s. x INSERT x INSERT s = x INSERT s

name: INSERT_INTER
display:
|- forall x s t.
       x INSERT s INTER t =
       (if x IN t then x INSERT (s INTER t) else s INTER t)

name: INSERT_RESTRICT
display:
|- forall P s a.
       {x | x IN a INSERT s /\ P x} =
       (if P a then a INSERT {x | x IN s /\ P x} else {x | x IN s /\ P x})

name: INSERT_SUBSET
display: |- forall x s t. x INSERT s SUBSET t <=> x IN t /\ s SUBSET t

name: INSERT_UNION
display:
|- forall x s t.
       x INSERT s UNION t =
       (if x IN t then s UNION t else x INSERT (s UNION t))

name: INSERT_UNION_EQ
display: |- forall x s t. x INSERT s UNION t = x INSERT (s UNION t)

name: INSERT_UNIV
display: |- forall x. x INSERT (:A) = (:A)

name: INTEGER_ABS
display: |- forall x. integer (abs x) <=> integer x

name: INTEGER_ABS_MUL_EQ_1
display:
|- forall x y.
       integer x /\ integer y
       ==> (abs (x * y) = &1 <=> abs x = &1 /\ abs y = &1)

name: INTEGER_ADD
display: |- forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (x + y)

name: INTEGER_ADD_EQ
display:
|- (forall x y. integer x ==> (integer (x + y) <=> integer y)) /\
   (forall x y. integer y ==> (integer (x + y) <=> integer x))

name: INTEGER_CASES
display: |- integer x <=> (exists n. x = &n) \/ (exists n. x = -- &n)

name: INTEGER_CLOSED
display:
|- (forall n. integer (&n)) /\
   (forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (x + y)) /\
   (forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (x - y)) /\
   (forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (x * y)) /\
   (forall x r. integer x ==> integer (x pow r)) /\
   (forall x. integer x ==> integer (--x)) /\
   (forall x. integer x ==> integer (abs x)) /\
   (forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (max x y)) /\
   (forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (min x y))

name: INTEGER_DIV
display: |- forall m n. integer (&m / &n) <=> n = 0 \/ n divides m

name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN
display: |- forall x y. x + &1 <= y ==> (exists n. integer n /\ x <= n /\ n < y)

name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ABS
display:
|- forall x y.
       &1 <= abs (x - y)
       ==> (exists n. integer n /\ (x <= n /\ n < y \/ y <= n /\ n < x))

name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ABS_LT
display:
|- forall x y.
       &1 < abs (x - y)
       ==> (exists n. integer n /\ (x < n /\ n < y \/ y < n /\ n < x))

name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ALT
display: |- forall x y. x + &1 <= y ==> (exists n. integer n /\ x < n /\ n <= y)

name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_LT
display: |- forall x y. x + &1 < y ==> (exists n. integer n /\ x < n /\ n < y)

name: INTEGER_MUL
display: |- forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (x * y)

name: INTEGER_NEG
display: |- forall x. integer (--x) <=> integer x

name: INTEGER_POS
display: |- forall x. &0 <= x ==> (integer x <=> (exists n. x = &n))

name: INTEGER_POW
display: |- forall x n. integer x ==> integer (x pow n)

name: INTEGER_REAL_OF_INT
display: |- forall x. integer (real_of_int x)

name: INTEGER_ROUND
display: |- forall x. exists n. integer n /\ abs (x - n) <= &1 / &2

name: INTEGER_SUB
display: |- forall x y. integer x /\ integer y ==> integer (x - y)

name: INTEGER_SUB_EQ
display:
|- (forall x y. integer x ==> (integer (x - y) <=> integer y)) /\
   (forall x y. integer y ==> (integer (x - y) <=> integer x))

name: INTEGER_SUM
display: |- forall f s. (forall x. x IN s ==> integer (f x)) ==> integer (sum s f)

name: INTER
display: |- forall s t. s INTER t = {x | x IN s /\ x IN t}

name: INTERS
display: |- forall s. INTERS s = {x | forall u. u IN s ==> x IN u}

name: INTERSECTION_OF
display:
|- forall P Q.
       P INTERSECTION_OF Q =
       (\s. exists u. P u /\ (forall c. c IN u ==> Q c) /\ INTERS u = s)

name: INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
display: |- forall P Q. P {} ==> (P INTERSECTION_OF Q) (:A)

name: INTERSECTION_OF_INC
display: |- forall P Q s. P {s} /\ Q s ==> (P INTERSECTION_OF Q) s

name: INTERSECTION_OF_MONO
display:
|- forall P Q Q' s.
       (P INTERSECTION_OF Q) s /\ (forall x. Q x ==> Q' x)
       ==> (P INTERSECTION_OF Q') s

name: INTERS_0
display: |- INTERS {} = (:A)

name: INTERS_1
display: |- forall s. INTERS {s} = s

name: INTERS_2
display: |- forall s t. INTERS {s, t} = s INTER t

name: INTERS_ANTIMONO
display: |- forall f g. g SUBSET f ==> INTERS f SUBSET INTERS g

name: INTERS_ANTIMONO_GEN
display:
|- forall s t.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ x SUBSET y))
       ==> INTERS s SUBSET INTERS t

name: INTERS_EQ_UNIV
display: |- forall f. INTERS f = (:A) <=> (forall s. s IN f ==> s = (:A))

name: INTERS_GSPEC
display:
|- (forall P f. INTERS {f x | P x} = {a | forall x. P x ==> a IN f x}) /\
   (forall P f.
        INTERS {f x y | P x y} = {a | forall x y. P x y ==> a IN f x y}) /\
   (forall P f.
        INTERS {f x y z | P x y z} =
        {a | forall x y z. P x y z ==> a IN f x y z})

name: INTERS_IMAGE
display: |- forall f s. INTERS (IMAGE f s) = {y | forall x. x IN s ==> y IN f x}

name: INTERS_INSERT
display: |- forall s u. INTERS (s INSERT u) = s INTER INTERS u

name: INTERS_IN_CHAIN
display:
|- forall f.
       FINITE f /\
       ~(f = {}) /\
       (forall s t. s IN f /\ t IN f ==> s SUBSET t \/ t SUBSET s)
       ==> INTERS f IN f

name: INTERS_OVER_UNIONS
INTERS_SUBSET
display:
|- forall u s.
       ~(u = {}) /\ (forall t. t IN u ==> t SUBSET s) ==> INTERS u SUBSET s

name: INTERS_SUBSET_STRONG
display: |- forall u s. (exists t. t IN u /\ t SUBSET s) ==> INTERS u SUBSET s

name: INTERS_UNION
display: |- forall s t. INTERS (s UNION t) = INTERS s INTER INTERS t

name: INTERS_UNIONS
display: |- forall s. INTERS s = (:A) DIFF UNIONS {(:A) DIFF t | t IN s}

name: INTER_ACI
display:
|- p INTER q = q INTER p /\
   (p INTER q) INTER r = p INTER q INTER r /\
   p INTER q INTER r = q INTER p INTER r /\
   p INTER p = p /\
   p INTER p INTER q = p INTER q

name: INTER_ASSOC
display: |- forall s t u. (s INTER t) INTER u = s INTER t INTER u

name: INTER_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall k s t.
       cartesian_product k s INTER cartesian_product k t =
       cartesian_product k (\i. s i INTER t i)

name: INTER_COMM
display: |- forall s t. s INTER t = t INTER s

name: INTER_CROSS
display:
|- forall s s' t t'.
       s CROSS t INTER s' CROSS t' = (s INTER s') CROSS (t INTER t')

name: INTER_DISJOINT_UNION
display:
|- forall k s t.

       if n = &0

       else &0 <= m rem n /\ m rem n < abs n /\ m = m div n * n + m rem n

name: INT_REM_UNIQ
display: |- forall m n q r. m = q * n + r /\ &0 <= r /\ r < abs n ==> m rem n = r

name: INT_REM_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall m n p.
       m rem n = p <=>
       (n = &0 /\ m = p \/ &0 <= p /\ p < abs n) /\ (m == p) (mod n)

name: INT_REM_ZERO
display: |- forall n. &0 rem n = &0

name: INT_RNEG_UNIQ
display: |- forall x y. x + y = &0 <=> y = --x

name: INT_SGN
display:
|- forall x.
       int_sgn x = (if &0 < x then &1 else if x < &0 then -- &1 else &0)

name: INT_SGN_ABS
display: |- forall x. int_sgn x * abs x = x

name: INT_SGN_ABS_ALT
display: |- forall x. int_sgn x * x = abs x

name: INT_SGN_CASES
display: |- forall x. int_sgn x = &0 \/ int_sgn x = &1 \/ int_sgn x = -- &1

name: INT_SGN_EQ
display:
|- (forall x. int_sgn x = &0 <=> x = &0) /\
   (forall x. int_sgn x = &1 <=> x > &0) /\
   (forall x. int_sgn x = -- &1 <=> x < &0)

name: INT_SGN_EQ_INEQ
display:
|- forall x y.
       int_sgn x = int_sgn y <=> x = y \/ abs (x - y) < max (abs x) (abs y)

name: INT_SGN_INEQS
display:
|- (forall x. &0 <= int_sgn x <=> &0 <= x) /\
   (forall x. &0 < int_sgn x <=> &0 < x) /\
   (forall x. &0 >= int_sgn x <=> &0 >= x) /\
   (forall x. &0 > int_sgn x <=> &0 > x) /\
   (forall x. &0 = int_sgn x <=> &0 = x) /\
   (forall x. int_sgn x <= &0 <=> x <= &0) /\
   (forall x. int_sgn x < &0 <=> x < &0) /\
   (forall x. int_sgn x >= &0 <=> x >= &0) /\
   (forall x. int_sgn x > &0 <=> x > &0) /\
   (forall x. int_sgn x = &0 <=> x = &0)

name: INT_SGN_INT_SGN
display: |- forall x. int_sgn (int_sgn x) = int_sgn x

name: INT_SGN_MUL
display: |- forall x y. int_sgn (x * y) = int_sgn x * int_sgn y

name: INT_SGN_NEG
display: |- forall x. int_sgn (--x) = --int_sgn x

name: INT_SGN_POW
display: |- forall x n. int_sgn (x pow n) = int_sgn x pow n

name: INT_SGN_POW_2
display: |- forall x. int_sgn (x pow 2) = int_sgn (abs x)

name: INT_SOS_EQ_0
display: |- forall x y. x pow 2 + y pow 2 = &0 <=> x = &0 /\ y = &0

name: INT_SUB
display: |- forall x y. x - y = x + --y

name: INT_SUB_0
display: |- forall x y. x - y = &0 <=> x = y

name: INT_SUB_ABS
display: |- forall x y. abs x - abs y <= abs (x - y)

name: INT_SUB_ADD
display: |- forall x y. x - y + y = x

name: INT_SUB_ADD2
display: |- forall x y. y + x - y = x

name: INT_SUB_LDISTRIB
display: |- forall x y z. x * (y - z) = x * y - x * z

name: INT_SUB_LE
display: |- forall x y. &0 <= x - y <=> y <= x

name: INT_SUB_LNEG
display: |- forall x y. --x - y = --(x + y)

name: INT_SUB_LT
display: |- forall x y. &0 < x - y <=> y < x

name: INT_SUB_LZERO
display: |- forall x. &0 - x = --x

name: INT_SUB_NEG2
display: |- forall x y. --x - --y = y - x

name: INT_SUB_POW
display:
|- forall x y n.
       1 <= n
       ==> x pow n - y pow n =
           (x - y) * isum (0..n - 1) (\i. x pow i * y pow (n - 1 - i))

name: INT_SUB_POW_L1
display:
|- forall x n.
       1 <= n ==> &1 - x pow n = (&1 - x) * isum (0..n - 1) (\i. x pow i)

name: INT_SUB_POW_R1
display:
|- forall x n.
       1 <= n ==> x pow n - &1 = (x - &1) * isum (0..n - 1) (\i. x pow i)

name: INT_SUB_RDISTRIB
display: |- forall x y z. (x - y) * z = x * z - y * z

name: INT_SUB_REFL
display: |- forall x. x - x = &0

name: INT_SUB_REM
display: |- forall m n p. (m rem p - n rem p) rem p = (m - n) rem p

name: INT_SUB_RNEG
display: |- forall x y. x - --y = x + y

name: INT_SUB_RZERO
display: |- forall x. x - &0 = x

name: INT_SUB_SUB
display: |- forall x y. x - y - x = --y

name: INT_SUB_SUB2
display: |- forall x y. x - (x - y) = y

name: INT_SUB_TRIANGLE
display: |- forall a b c. a - b + b - c = a - c

name: INT_WLOG_LE
display:
|- (forall x y. P x y <=> P y x) /\ (forall x y. x <= y ==> P x y)
   ==> (forall x y. P x y)

name: INT_WLOG_LE_3
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall x y z. P x y z ==> P y x z /\ P x z y) /\
       (forall x y z. x <= y /\ y <= z ==> P x y z)
       ==> (forall x y z. P x y z)

name: INT_WLOG_LT
display:
|- (forall x. P x x) /\
   (forall x y. P x y <=> P y x) /\
   (forall x y. x < y ==> P x y)
   ==> (forall x y. P x y)

name: INT_WOP
display:
|- (exists x. &0 <= x /\ P x) <=>
   (exists x. &0 <= x /\ P x /\ (forall y. &0 <= y /\ P y ==> x <= y))

name: INV
display: |- forall R y x. INV R x y <=> R y x

name: INVERSE_MOD_1
display: |- forall n. inverse_mod n 1 = 1

name: INVERSE_MOD_BOUND
display: |- forall n x. inverse_mod n x < n <=> 2 <= n

name: INVERSE_MOD_BOUND_LE
display: |- forall n a. inverse_mod n a <= n <=> ~(n = 0)

name: INVERSE_MOD_CONG
display: |- forall n x y. (x == y) (mod n) ==> inverse_mod n x = inverse_mod n y

name: INVERSE_MOD_INVERSE_MOD
display:
|- forall n x.
       coprime (n,x) /\ 1 <= x /\ x <= n
       ==> inverse_mod n (inverse_mod n x) = x

name: INVERSE_MOD_INVERSE_MOD_CONG
display:
|- forall n x.
       coprime (n,x) ==> (inverse_mod n (inverse_mod n x) == x) (mod n)

name: INVERSE_MOD_INVERSION
display:
|- forall m n.
       coprime (m,n)
       ==> m * inverse_mod n m + n * inverse_mod m n = m * n + 1

name: INVERSE_MOD_LMUL
display: |- forall n x. coprime (n,x) ==> (inverse_mod n x * x == 1) (mod n)

name: INVERSE_MOD_LMUL_EQ
display: |- forall n x. (inverse_mod n x * x == 1) (mod n) <=> coprime (n,x)

name: INVERSE_MOD_LMUL_GEN
display: |- forall n x. (inverse_mod n x * x == gcd (n,x)) (mod n)

name: INVERSE_MOD_NONZERO
display: |- forall n a. coprime (n,a) ==> ~(inverse_mod n a = 0)

name: INVERSE_MOD_NONZERO_ALT
display: |- forall n a. ~(n divides a) ==> ~(inverse_mod n a = 0)

name: INVERSE_MOD_RMUL
display: |- forall n x. coprime (n,x) ==> (x * inverse_mod n x == 1) (mod n)

name: INVERSE_MOD_RMUL_EQ
display: |- forall n x. (x * inverse_mod n x == 1) (mod n) <=> coprime (n,x)

name: INVERSE_MOD_RMUL_GEN
display: |- forall n x. (x * inverse_mod n x == gcd (n,x)) (mod n)

name: INVERSE_MOD_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall n a x.
       (a * x == 1) (mod n) /\ x <= n /\ ~(n = 1 /\ x = 0)
       ==> inverse_mod n a = x

name: INVOLUTION_EVEN_FIXPOINTS
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN s /\ f (f x) = x)
       ==> (EVEN (CARD {x | x IN s /\ f x = x}) <=> EVEN (CARD s))

name: INVOLUTION_EVEN_NOFIXPOINTS
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN s /\ ~(f x = x) /\ f (f x) = x)
       ==> EVEN (CARD s)

name: IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall k s x.
       x IN cartesian_product k s <=>
       EXTENSIONAL k x /\ (forall i. i IN k ==> x i IN s i)

name: IN_CROSS
display: |- forall x y s t. x,y IN s CROSS t <=> x IN s /\ y IN t

name: IN_DELETE
display: |- forall s x y. x IN s DELETE y <=> x IN s /\ ~(x = y)

name: IN_DELETE_EQ
display:
|- forall s x x'.
       (x IN s <=> x' IN s) <=> x IN s DELETE x' <=> x' IN s DELETE x

name: IN_DIFF
display: |- forall s t x. x IN s DIFF t <=> x IN s /\ ~(x IN t)

name: IN_DISJOINT
display: |- forall s t. DISJOINT s t <=> ~(exists x. x IN s /\ x IN t)

name: IN_ELIM_PAIR_THM
display: |- forall P a b. a,b IN {x,y | P x y} <=> P a b

name: IN_ELIM_PASTECART_THM
display: |- forall P a b. pastecart a b IN {pastecart x y | P x y} <=> P a b

name: IN_ELIM_QUAD_THM
display:
|- (forall P a b c d. a,b,c,d IN {w,x,y,z | P w x y z} <=> P a b c d) /\
   (forall P a b c d. (a,b),c,d IN {(w,x),y,z | P w x y z} <=> P a b c d) /\
   (forall P a b c d. ((a,b),c),d IN {((w,x),y),z | P w x y z} <=> P a b c d)

name: IN_ELIM_THM
display:
|- (forall P x. x IN GSPEC (\v. P (SETSPEC v)) <=> P (\p t. p /\ x = t)) /\
   (forall p x. x IN {y | p y} <=> p x) /\
   (forall P x. GSPEC (\v. P (SETSPEC v)) x <=> P (\p t. p /\ x = t)) /\
   (forall p x. {y | p y} x <=> p x) /\
   (forall p x. x IN (\y. p y) <=> p x)

name: IN_ELIM_TRIPLE_THM
display:
|- (forall P a b c. a,b,c IN {x,y,z | P x y z} <=> P a b c) /\
   (forall P a b c. (a,b),c IN {(x,y),z | P x y z} <=> P a b c)

name: IN_EXTENSIONAL
display: |- forall s f. f IN EXTENSIONAL s <=> (forall x. ~(x IN s) ==> f x = ARB)

name: IN_EXTENSIONAL_UNDEFINED
display: |- forall s f x. f IN EXTENSIONAL s /\ ~(x IN s) ==> f x = ARB

name: IN_FLD
display: |- forall l x. x IN fld l <=> (exists y. l x y \/ l y x)

name: IN_GSPEC
display: |- forall s. {x | x IN s} = s

name: IN_IMAGE
display: |- forall y s f. y IN IMAGE f s <=> (exists x. y = f x /\ x IN s)

name: IN_INSERT
display: |- forall x y s. x IN y INSERT s <=> x = y \/ x IN s

name: IN_INTER
display: |- forall s t x. x IN s INTER t <=> x IN s /\ x IN t

name: IN_INTERS
display: |- forall s x. x IN INTERS s <=> (forall t. t IN s ==> x IN t)

name: IN_NUMSEG
display: |- forall m n p. p IN m..n <=> m <= p /\ p <= n

name: IN_NUMSEG_0
display: |- forall m n. m IN 0..n <=> m <= n

name: IN_REST
display: |- forall x s. x IN REST s <=> x IN s /\ ~(x = CHOICE s)

name: IN_SET_OF_LIST
display: |- forall x l. x IN set_of_list l <=> MEM x l

name: IN_SING
display: |- forall x y. x IN {y} <=> x = y

name: IN_SUPPORT
display: |- forall op f x s. x IN support op f s <=> x IN s /\ ~(f x = neutral op)

name: IN_UNION
display: |- forall s t x. x IN s UNION t <=> x IN s \/ x IN t

name: IN_UNIONS
display: |- forall s x. x IN UNIONS s <=> (exists t. t IN s /\ x IN t)

name: IN_UNIV
display: |- forall x. x IN (:A)

name: IPRODUCT_ADD_SPLIT
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       m <= n + 1
       ==> iproduct (m..n + p) f =
           iproduct (m..n) f * iproduct (n + 1..n + p) f

name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall f. iproduct {} f = &1) /\
   (forall x f s.
        FINITE s
        ==> iproduct (x INSERT s) f =
            (if x IN s then iproduct s f else f x * iproduct s f))

name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_LEFT
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> iproduct (m..n) f = f m * iproduct (m + 1..n) f

name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
display:
|- (forall m. iproduct (m..0) f = (if m = 0 then f 0 else &1)) /\
   (forall m n.
        iproduct (m..SUC n) f =
        (if m <= SUC n
         then iproduct (m..n) f * f (SUC n)
         else iproduct (m..n) f))

name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_RIGHT
display:
|- forall f m n.
       0 < n /\ m <= n ==> iproduct (m..n) f = iproduct (m..n - 1) f * f n

name: IPRODUCT_CLOSED
display:
|- forall P f s.
       P (&1) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x * y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (iproduct s f)

name: IPRODUCT_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall P f s.
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x * y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (iproduct s f)

name: IPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG
display: |- forall c m n. iproduct (m..n) (\x. c) = c pow ((n + 1) - m)

name: IPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG_1
display: |- forall c n. iproduct (1..n) (\x. c) = c pow n

name: IPRODUCT_EQ_0_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       iproduct (m..n) f = &0 <=> (exists x. m <= x /\ x <= n /\ f x = &0)

name: IPRODUCT_EQ_1
display: |- forall f s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = &1) ==> iproduct s f = &1

name: IPRODUCT_EQ_1_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = &1) ==> iproduct (m..n) f = &1

name: IPRODUCT_EQ_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = g i)
       ==> iproduct (m..n) f = iproduct (m..n) g

name: IPRODUCT_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> &0 <= f i /\ f i <= g i)
       ==> iproduct (m..n) f <= iproduct (m..n) g

name: IPRODUCT_MUL_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       iproduct (m..n) (\x. f x * g x) =
       iproduct (m..n) f * iproduct (m..n) g

name: IPRODUCT_NEG
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s ==> iproduct s (\i. --f i) = -- &1 pow CARD s * iproduct s f

name: IPRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       iproduct (m..n) (\i. --f i) =
       -- &1 pow ((n + 1) - m) * iproduct (m..n) f

name: IPRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG_1
display: |- forall f n. iproduct (1..n) (\i. --f i) = -- &1 pow n * iproduct (1..n) f

name: IPRODUCT_OFFSET
display: |- forall f m p. iproduct (m + p..n + p) f = iproduct (m..n) (\i. f (i + p))

name: IPRODUCT_PAIR
display:
|- forall f m n.
       iproduct (2 * m..2 * n + 1) f =
       iproduct (m..n) (\i. f (2 * i) * f (2 * i + 1))

name: IPRODUCT_POS_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall x. m <= x /\ x <= n ==> &0 <= f x) ==> &0 <= iproduct (m..n) f

name: IPRODUCT_POS_LT_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall x. m <= x /\ x <= n ==> &0 < f x) ==> &0 < iproduct (m..n) f

name: IPRODUCT_REFLECT
display:
|- forall x m n.
       iproduct (m..n) x =
       (if n < m then &1 else iproduct (0..n - m) (\i. x (n - i)))

name: IPRODUCT_RELATED
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       R (&1) (&1) /\
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m * m') (n * n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       (forall i. i IN s ==> R (f i) (g i))
       ==> R (iproduct s f) (iproduct s g)

name: IPRODUCT_RELATED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m * m') (n * n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall i. i IN s ==> R (f i) (g i))
       ==> R (iproduct s f) (iproduct s g)

name: IPRODUCT_RESTRICT_SET
display:
|- forall P s f.
       iproduct {i | i IN s /\ P i} f =
       iproduct s (\i. if P i then f i else &1)

name: IPRODUCT_SING_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f n. iproduct (n..n) f = f n

name: IPRODUCT_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f u v.
       u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = &1)
       ==> iproduct v f = iproduct u f

name: IPRODUCT_UNIV
display: |- forall f s. support (*) f (:A) SUBSET s ==> iproduct s f = iproduct (:A) f

name: ISO
display: |- forall g f. ISO f g <=> (forall x. f (g x) = x) /\ (forall y. g (f y) = y)

name: ISO_FUN
display: |- ISO f f' /\ ISO g g' ==> ISO (\h a'. g (h (f' a'))) (\h a. g' (h (f a)))

name: ISO_REFL
display: |- ISO (\x. x) (\x. x)

name: ISO_USAGE
display:
|- ISO f g
   ==> (forall P. (forall x. P x) <=> (forall x. P (g x))) /\
       (forall P. (exists x. P x) <=> (exists x. P (g x))) /\
       (forall a b. a = g b <=> f a = b)

name: ISUM_0
display: |- forall s. isum s (\n. &0) = &0

name: ISUM_ABS
display: |- forall f s. FINITE s ==> abs (isum s f) <= isum s (\x. abs (f x))

name: ISUM_ABS_BOUND
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> abs (f x) <= b)
       ==> abs (isum s f) <= &(CARD s) * b

name: ISUM_ABS_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> abs (f x) <= g x)
       ==> abs (isum s f) <= isum s g

name: ISUM_ABS_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f m n. abs (isum (m..n) f) <= isum (m..n) (\i. abs (f i))

name: ISUM_ADD
display: |- forall f g s. FINITE s ==> isum s (\x. f x + g x) = isum s f + isum s g

name: ISUM_ADD_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       isum (m..n) (\i. f i + g i) = isum (m..n) f + isum (m..n) g

name: ISUM_ADD_SPLIT
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       m <= n + 1
       ==> isum (m..n + p) f = isum (m..n) f + isum (n + 1..n + p) f

name: ISUM_BIJECTION
display:
|- forall f p s.
       (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
       (forall y. y IN s ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ p x = y))
       ==> isum s f = isum s (f o p)

name: ISUM_BOUND
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b)
       ==> isum s f <= &(CARD s) * b

name: ISUM_BOUND_LT
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ f x < b)
       ==> isum s f < &(CARD s) * b

name: ISUM_BOUND_LT_ALL
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x < b)
       ==> isum s f < &(CARD s) * b

name: ISUM_CASES
display:
|- forall s P f g.
       FINITE s
       ==> isum s (\x. if P x then f x else g x) =
           isum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f + isum {x | x IN s /\ ~P x} g

name: ISUM_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall f. isum {} f = &0) /\
   (forall x f s.
        FINITE s
        ==> isum (x INSERT s) f =
            (if x IN s then isum s f else f x + isum s f))

name: ISUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> isum (m..n) f = f m + isum (m + 1..n) f

name: ISUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
display:
|- (forall m. isum (m..0) f = (if m = 0 then f 0 else &0)) /\
   (forall m n.
        isum (m..SUC n) f =
        (if m <= SUC n then isum (m..n) f + f (SUC n) else isum (m..n) f))

name: ISUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
display: |- forall f m n. 0 < n /\ m <= n ==> isum (m..n) f = isum (m..n - 1) f + f n

name: ISUM_CLOSED
display:
|- forall P f s.
       P (&0) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (isum s f)

name: ISUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall P f s.
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (isum s f)

name: ISUM_COMBINE_L
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       0 < n /\ m <= n /\ n <= p + 1
       ==> isum (m..n - 1) f + isum (n..p) f = isum (m..p) f

name: ISUM_COMBINE_R
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p
       ==> isum (m..n) f + isum (n + 1..p) f = isum (m..p) f

name: ISUM_CONST
display: |- forall c s. FINITE s ==> isum s (\n. c) = &(CARD s) * c

name: ISUM_CONST_NUMSEG
display: |- forall c m n. isum (m..n) (\n. c) = &((n + 1) - m) * c

name: ISUM_DELETE
display: |- forall f s a. FINITE s /\ a IN s ==> isum (s DELETE a) f = isum s f - f a

name: ISUM_DELETE_CASES
display:
|- forall f s a.
       FINITE s
       ==> isum (s DELETE a) f =
           (if a IN s then isum s f - f a else isum s f)

name: ISUM_DELTA
display:
|- forall s a.
       isum s (\x. if x = a then b else &0) = (if a IN s then b else &0)

name: ISUM_DIFF
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ t SUBSET s ==> isum (s DIFF t) f = isum s f - isum t f

name: ISUM_DIFFS
display:
|- forall m n.
       isum (m..n) (\k. f k - f (k + 1)) =
       (if m <= n then f m - f (n + 1) else &0)

name: ISUM_EQ
display: |- forall f g s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x) ==> isum s f = isum s g

name: ISUM_EQ_0
display: |- forall f s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = &0) ==> isum s f = &0

name: ISUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = &0) ==> isum (m..n) f = &0

name: ISUM_EQ_GENERAL
display:
|- forall s t f g h.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ h x = y)) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ g (h x) = f x)
       ==> isum s f = isum t g

name: ISUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
display:
|- forall s t f g h k.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> k y IN s /\ h (k y) = y) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)
       ==> isum s f = isum t g

name: ISUM_EQ_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = g i)
       ==> isum (m..n) f = isum (m..n) g

name: ISUM_EQ_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE t /\
       t SUBSET s /\
       (forall x. x IN t ==> f x = g x) /\
       (forall x. x IN s /\ ~(x IN t) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> isum s f = isum t g

name: ISUM_GROUP
display:
|- forall f g s t.
       FINITE s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t
       ==> isum t (\y. isum {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g) = isum s g

name: ISUM_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> isum (IMAGE f s) g = isum s (g o f)

name: ISUM_IMAGE_GEN
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s
       ==> isum s g = isum (IMAGE f s) (\y. isum {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g)

name: ISUM_IMAGE_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= g (f x))
       ==> isum (IMAGE f s) g <= isum s (g o f)

name: ISUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
display:
|- forall d i s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x y.
            x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) /\ i x = i y ==> d (i x) = &0)
       ==> isum (IMAGE i s) d = isum s (d o i)

name: ISUM_INCL_EXCL
display:
|- forall s t f.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> isum s f + isum t f = isum (s UNION t) f + isum (s INTER t) f

name: ISUM_INJECTION
display:
|- forall f p s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ p x = p y ==> x = y)
       ==> isum s (f o p) = isum s f

name: ISUM_ISUM_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall s t x.
       FINITE s /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> FINITE (t i))
       ==> isum s (\i. isum (t i) (x i)) =
           isum {i,j | i IN s /\ j IN t i} (\(i,j). x i j)

name: ISUM_ISUM_RESTRICT
display:
|- forall R f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> isum s (\x. isum {y | y IN t /\ R x y} (f x)) =
           isum t (\y. isum {x | x IN s /\ R x y} (\x. f x y))

name: ISUM_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) ==> isum s f <= isum s g

name: ISUM_LE_INCLUDED
display:
|- forall f g s t i.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall y. y IN t ==> &0 <= g y) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> (exists y. y IN t /\ i y = x /\ f x <= g y))
       ==> isum s f <= isum t g

name: ISUM_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i <= g i)
       ==> isum (m..n) f <= isum (m..n) g

name: ISUM_LMUL
display: |- forall f c s. isum s (\x. c * f x) = c * isum s f

name: ISUM_LT
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ f x < g x)
       ==> isum s f < isum s g

name: ISUM_LT_ALL
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x < g x)
       ==> isum s f < isum s g

name: ISUM_MULTICOUNT
display:
|- forall R s t k.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall j. j IN t ==> CARD {i | i IN s /\ R i j} = k)
       ==> isum s (\i. &(CARD {j | j IN t /\ R i j})) = &(k * CARD t)

name: ISUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
display:
|- forall R s t k.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall j. j IN t ==> CARD {i | i IN s /\ R i j} = k j)
       ==> isum s (\i. &(CARD {j | j IN t /\ R i j})) = isum t (\i. &(k i))

name: ISUM_NEG
display: |- forall f s. isum s (\x. --f x) = --isum s f

name: ISUM_OFFSET
display: |- forall p f m n. isum (m + p..n + p) f = isum (m..n) (\i. f (i + p))

name: ISUM_OFFSET_0
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> isum (m..n) f = isum (0..n - m) (\i. f (i + m))

name: ISUM_PARTIAL_PRE
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       isum (m..n) (\k. f k * (g k - g (k - 1))) =
       (if m <= n
        then f (n + 1) * g n -
             f m * g (m - 1) -
             isum (m..n) (\k. g k * (f (k + 1) - f k))
        else &0)

name: ISUM_PARTIAL_SUC
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       isum (m..n) (\k. f k * (g (k + 1) - g k)) =
       (if m <= n
        then f (n + 1) * g (n + 1) -
             f m * g m -
             isum (m..n) (\k. g (k + 1) * (f (k + 1) - f k))
        else &0)

name: ISUM_POS_BOUND
display:
|- forall f b s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\ isum s f <= b
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b)

name: ISUM_POS_EQ_0
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\ isum s f = &0
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = &0)

name: ISUM_POS_EQ_0_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> &0 <= f p) /\ isum (m..n) f = &0
       ==> (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> f p = &0)

name: ISUM_POS_LE
display: |- forall s. (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) ==> &0 <= isum s f

name: ISUM_POS_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall m n f.
       (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> &0 <= f p) ==> &0 <= isum (m..n) f

name: ISUM_RELATED
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       R (&0) (&0) /\
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m + m') (n + n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
       ==> R (isum s f) (isum s g)

name: ISUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m + m') (n + n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
       ==> R (isum s f) (isum s g)

name: ISUM_RESTRICT
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s ==> isum s (\x. if x IN s then f x else &0) = isum s f

name: ISUM_RESTRICT_SET
display:
|- forall P s f.
       isum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f = isum s (\x. if P x then f x else &0)

name: ISUM_RMUL
display: |- forall f c s. isum s (\x. f x * c) = isum s f * c

name: ISUM_SING
display: |- forall f x. isum {x} f = f x

name: ISUM_SING_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f n. isum (n..n) f = f n

name: ISUM_SUB
display: |- forall f g s. FINITE s ==> isum s (\x. f x - g x) = isum s f - isum s g

name: ISUM_SUBSET
display:
|- forall u v f.
       FINITE u /\
       FINITE v /\
       (forall x. x IN u DIFF v ==> f x <= &0) /\
       (forall x. x IN v DIFF u ==> &0 <= f x)
       ==> isum u f <= isum v f

name: ISUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
display:
|- forall u v f.
       FINITE v /\ u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v DIFF u ==> &0 <= f x)
       ==> isum u f <= isum v f

name: ISUM_SUB_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       isum (m..n) (\i. f i - g i) = isum (m..n) f - isum (m..n) g

name: ISUM_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f u v.
       u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> isum v f = isum u f

name: ISUM_SWAP
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> isum s (\i. isum t (f i)) = isum t (\j. isum s (\i. f i j))

name: ISUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall a b c d f.
       isum (a..b) (\i. isum (c..d) (f i)) =
       isum (c..d) (\j. isum (a..b) (\i. f i j))

name: ISUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f m n. n < m ==> isum (m..n) f = &0

name: ISUM_UNION
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ DISJOINT s t
       ==> isum (s UNION t) f = isum s f + isum t f

name: ISUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall t. t IN s ==> FINITE t) /\
       (forall t1 t2 x.
            t1 IN s /\ t2 IN s /\ ~(t1 = t2) /\ x IN t1 /\ x IN t2
            ==> f x = &0)
       ==> isum (UNIONS s) f = isum s (\t. isum t f)

name: ISUM_UNION_EQ
display:
|- forall s t u.
       FINITE u /\ s INTER t = {} /\ s UNION t = u
       ==> isum s f + isum t f = isum u f

name: ISUM_UNION_LZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE v /\ (forall x. x IN u /\ ~(x IN v) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> isum (u UNION v) f = isum v f

name: ISUM_UNION_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ (forall x. x IN s INTER t ==> f x = &0)
       ==> isum (s UNION t) f = isum s f + isum t f

name: ISUM_UNION_RZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE u /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> isum (u UNION v) f = isum u f

name: ISUM_UNIV
display: |- forall f s. support (+) f (:A) SUBSET s ==> isum s f = isum (:A) f

name: ISUM_ZERO_EXISTS
display:
|- forall u s.
       FINITE s /\ isum s u = &0
       ==> (forall i. i IN s ==> u i = &0) \/
           (exists j k. j IN s /\ u j < &0 /\ k IN s /\ u k > &0)

name: ITERATE_BIJECTION
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f p s.
                (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
                (forall y. y IN s ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ p x = y))
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op s (f o p))

name: ITERATE_CASES
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s P f g.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op s (\x. if P x then f x else g x) =
                    op (iterate op {x | x IN s /\ P x} f)
                    (iterate op {x | x IN s /\ ~P x} g))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f. iterate op {} f = neutral op) /\
           (forall f x s.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op (x INSERT s) f =
                    (if x IN s
                     then iterate op s f
                     else op (f x) (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f. iterate op {} f = neutral op) /\
           (forall f x s.
                FINITE (support op f s)
                ==> iterate op (x INSERT s) f =
                    (if x IN s
                     then iterate op s f
                     else op (f x) (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall m.
                iterate op (m..0) f = (if m = 0 then f 0 else neutral op)) /\
           (forall m n.
                iterate op (m..SUC n) f =
                (if m <= SUC n
                 then op (iterate op (m..n) f) (f (SUC n))
                 else iterate op (m..n) f))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> iterate op {i | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\
           (forall k.
                iterate op {i | i <= SUC k} f =
                op (iterate op {i | i <= k} f) (f (SUC k)))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> iterate op {i | i < 0} f = neutral op /\
           (forall k.
                iterate op {i | i < SUC k} f =
                op (iterate op {i | i < k} f) (f k))

name: ITERATE_CLOSED
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall P.
                P (neutral op) /\ (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (op x y))
                ==> (forall f s.
                         (forall x.
                              x IN s /\ ~(f x = neutral op) ==> P (f x))
                         ==> P (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall P.
                (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (op x y))
                ==> (forall f s.
                         FINITE s /\
                         ~(s = {}) /\
                         (forall x. x IN s ==> P (f x))
                         ==> P (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_DELETE
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s a.
                FINITE s /\ a IN s
                ==> op (f a) (iterate op (s DELETE a) f) = iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_DELTA
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f a s.
                iterate op s (\x. if x = a then f x else neutral op) =
                (if a IN s then f a else neutral op))

name: ITERATE_DIFF
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE s /\ t SUBSET s
                ==> op (iterate op (s DIFF t) f) (iterate op t f) =
                    iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_DIFF_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE (support op f s) /\
                support op f t SUBSET support op f s
                ==> op (iterate op (s DIFF t) f) (iterate op t f) =
                    iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_EQ
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x)
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op s g)

name: ITERATE_EQ_GENERAL
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t f g h.
                (forall y. y IN t ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ h x = y)) /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ g (h x) = f x)
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op t g)

name: ITERATE_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t f g h k.
                (forall y. y IN t ==> k y IN s /\ h (k y) = y) /\
                (forall x.
                     x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op t g)

name: ITERATE_EQ_NEUTRAL
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s.
                (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = neutral op)
                ==> iterate op s f = neutral op)

name: ITERATE_EXPAND_CASES
display:
|- forall op f s.
       iterate op s f =
       (if FINITE (support op f s)
        then iterate op (support op f s) f
        else neutral op)

name: ITERATE_GCD_DIVIDES
display:
|- forall f k i.
       FINITE k /\ i IN k ==> iterate (\m n. gcd (m,n)) k f divides f i

name: ITERATE_GCD_DIVIDES_EQ
display:
|- forall f k i.
       i IN k
       ==> (iterate (\m n. gcd (m,n)) k f divides f i <=>
            FINITE {j | j IN k /\ ~(f j = 0)} \/ f i = 0)

name: ITERATE_GCD_EQ_0
display:
|- forall k f.
       FINITE k
       ==> (iterate (\m n. gcd (m,n)) k f = 0 <=>
            (forall j. j IN k ==> f j = 0))

name: ITERATE_GCD_EQ_0_GEN
display:
|- forall k f.
       iterate (\m n. gcd (m,n)) k f = 0 <=>
       FINITE {j | j IN k /\ ~(f j = 0)} ==> (forall j. j IN k ==> f j = 0)

name: ITERATE_IMAGE
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
                ==> iterate op (IMAGE f s) g = iterate op s (g o f))

name: ITERATE_IMAGE_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op s g =
                    iterate op (IMAGE f s)
                    (\y. iterate op {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g))

name: ITERATE_IMAGE_NONZERO
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall g f s.
                FINITE s /\
                (forall x y.
                     x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) /\ f x = f y
                     ==> g (f x) = neutral op)
                ==> iterate op (IMAGE f s) g = iterate op s (g o f))

name: ITERATE_INCL_EXCL
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t f.
                FINITE s /\ FINITE t
                ==> op (iterate op s f) (iterate op t f) =
                    op (iterate op (s UNION t) f) (iterate op (s INTER t) f))

name: ITERATE_INJECTION
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f p s.
                FINITE s /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ p x = p y ==> x = y)
                ==> iterate op s (f o p) = iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_ITERATE_DIVISORS
display:
|- forall op f x.
       monoidal op
       ==> iterate op (1..x) (\n. iterate op {d | d divides n} (f n)) =
           iterate op (1..x) (\n. iterate op (1..x DIV n) (\k. f (k * n) n))

name: ITERATE_ITERATE_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t x.
                FINITE s /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> FINITE (t i))
                ==> iterate op s (\i. iterate op (t i) (x i)) =
                    iterate op {i,j | i IN s /\ j IN t i} (\(i,j). x i j))

name: ITERATE_LCM_DIVIDES
display:
|- forall f k n.
       FINITE k
       ==> (iterate (\m n. lcm (m,n)) k f divides n <=>
            (forall i. i IN k ==> f i divides n))

name: ITERATE_LCM_DIVIDES_GEN
display:
|- forall f k n.
       iterate (\m n. lcm (m,n)) k f divides n <=>
       FINITE {j | j IN k /\ ~(f j = 1)}
       ==> (forall i. i IN k ==> f i divides n)

name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_0
display:
|- forall k f.
       FINITE k
       ==> (iterate (\m n. lcm (m,n)) k f = 0 <=>
            (exists j. j IN k /\ f j = 0))

name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_0_GEN
display:
|- forall k f.
       iterate (\m n. lcm (m,n)) k f = 0 <=>
       FINITE {j | j IN k /\ ~(f j = 1)} /\ (exists j. j IN k /\ f j = 0)

name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_1
display:
|- forall k f.
       FINITE k
       ==> (iterate (\m n. lcm (m,n)) k f = 1 <=>
            (forall j. j IN k ==> f j = 1))

name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_1_GEN
display:
|- forall k f.
       iterate (\m n. lcm (m,n)) k f = 1 <=>
       FINITE {j | j IN k /\ ~(f j = 1)} ==> (forall j. j IN k ==> f j = 1)

name: ITERATE_OP
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op s (\x. op (f x) (g x)) =
                    op (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g))

name: ITERATE_OP_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                FINITE (support op f s) /\ FINITE (support op g s)
                ==> iterate op s (\x. op (f x) (g x)) =
                    op (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g))

name: ITERATE_PAIR
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f m n.
                iterate op (2 * m..2 * n + 1) f =
                iterate op (m..n) (\i. op (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1))))

name: ITERATE_REFLECT
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall x m n.
                iterate op (m..n) x =
                (if n < m
                 then neutral op
                 else iterate op (0..n - m) (\i. x (n - i))))

name: ITERATE_RELATED
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall R.
                R (neutral op) (neutral op) /\
                (forall x1 y1 x2 y2.
                     R x1 x2 /\ R y1 y2 ==> R (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2))
                ==> (forall f g s.

       ==> (forall R.
                (forall x1 y1 x2 y2.
                     R x1 x2 /\ R y1 y2 ==> R (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2))
                ==> (forall f g s.
                         FINITE s /\

                         ==> R (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g)))

name: ITERATO_CLAUSES

|- forall dom neut op (<<=) f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) {} f = neut /\
       (forall i k.
            FINITE {i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
            (forall j. j IN k ==> i <<= j /\ ~(j <<= i))
            ==> iterato dom neut op (<<=) (i INSERT k) f =
                (if f i IN dom ==> f i = neut \/ i IN k
                 then iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f
                 else op (f i) (iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f)))

name: ITERATO_CLAUSES_EXISTS
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) {} f = neut /\
       (forall k.
            FINITE {i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
            ~({i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} = {})
            ==> (exists i.
                     i IN k /\
                     f i IN dom DIFF {neut} /\
                     iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f =
                     op (f i) (iterato dom neut op (<<=) (k DELETE i) f)))

name: ITERATO_CLAUSES_GEN
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) {} f = neut /\
       (forall i k.
            FINITE {j | j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
            (forall j. j IN k ==> i = j \/ i <<= j \/ j <<= i) /\
            (forall j. j <<= i /\ j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut} ==> j = i)
            ==> iterato dom neut op (<<=) (i INSERT k) f =
                (if f i IN dom ==> f i = neut \/ i IN k
                 then iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f
                 else op (f i) (iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f)))

             then iterato dom neut op (<=) (m + 1..n) f
             else op (f m) (iterato dom neut op (<=) (m + 1..n) f)
        else neut)

name: ITERATO_CLOSED
display:
