name: LUCAS
display:
|- forall a n.
       2 <= n /\
       (a EXP (n - 1) == 1) (mod n) /\
       (forall p.
            prime p /\ p divides n - 1
            ==> ~(a EXP ((n - 1) DIV p) == 1) (mod n))
       ==> prime n

name: LUCAS_COPRIME_LEMMA
display: |- forall m n a. ~(m = 0) /\ (a EXP m == 1) (mod n) ==> coprime (a,n)

name: LUCAS_PRIMEFACT
display:
|- 2 <= n /\
   (a EXP (n - 1) == 1) (mod n) /\
   ITLIST (*) ps 1 = n - 1 /\
   ALL (\p. prime p /\ ~(a EXP ((n - 1) DIV p) == 1) (mod n)) ps
   ==> prime n

name: LUCAS_WEAK
display:
|- forall a n.
       2 <= n /\
       (a EXP (n - 1) == 1) (mod n) /\
       (forall m. 0 < m /\ m < n - 1 ==> ~(a EXP m == 1) (mod n))
       ==> prime n

name: MAP
display:
|- (forall f. MAP f [] = []) /\
   (forall f h t. MAP f (CONS h t) = CONS (f h) (MAP f t))

name: MAP2
display:
|- MAP2 f [] [] = [] /\
   MAP2 f (CONS h1 t1) (CONS h2 t2) = CONS (f h1 h2) (MAP2 f t1 t2)

name: MAP2_DEF
display:
|- MAP2 f [] l = [] /\
   MAP2 f (CONS h1 t1) l = CONS (f h1 (HD l)) (MAP2 f t1 (TL l))

name: MAP_APPEND
display: |- forall f l1 l2. MAP f (APPEND l1 l2) = APPEND (MAP f l1) (MAP f l2)

name: MAP_EQ
display: |- forall f g l. ALL (\x. f x = g x) l ==> MAP f l = MAP g l

name: MAP_EQ_ALL2
display: |- forall f l m. ALL2 (\x y. f x = f y) l m ==> MAP f l = MAP f m

name: MAP_EQ_DEGEN
display: |- forall l f. ALL (\x. f x = x) l ==> MAP f l = l

name: MAP_EQ_NIL
display: |- forall f l. MAP f l = [] <=> l = []

name: MAP_FST_ZIP
display: |- forall l1 l2. LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2 ==> MAP FST (ZIP l1 l2) = l1

name: MAP_I
display: |- MAP I = I

name: MAP_ID
display: |- forall l. MAP (\x. x) l = l

name: MAP_LIST_OF_SEQ
display: |- forall f g n. MAP g (list_of_seq f n) = list_of_seq (g o f) n

name: MAP_REVERSE
display: |- forall f l. REVERSE (MAP f l) = MAP f (REVERSE l)

name: MAP_SND_ZIP
display: |- forall l1 l2. LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2 ==> MAP SND (ZIP l1 l2) = l2

name: MAP_o
display: |- forall f g l. MAP (g o f) l = MAP g (MAP f l)

name: MAX
display: |- forall m n. MAX m n = (if m <= n then n else m)

name: MAX_LE_LCM
display: |- forall m n. (m = 0 <=> n = 0) ==> MAX m n <= lcm (m,n)

name: MAX_LE_LCM_EQ
display: |- forall m n. MAX m n <= lcm (m,n) <=> m = 0 <=> n = 0

name: MEASURE
display: |- forall m. MEASURE m = (\x y. m x < m y)

name: MEASURE_LE
display: |- forall m. (forall y. MEASURE m y a ==> MEASURE m y b) <=> m a <= m b

name: MEM
display: |- (MEM x [] <=> false) /\ (MEM x (CONS h t) <=> x = h \/ MEM x t)

name: MEMBER_NOT_EMPTY
display: |- forall s. (exists x. x IN s) <=> ~(s = {})

name: MEM_APPEND
display: |- forall x l1 l2. MEM x (APPEND l1 l2) <=> MEM x l1 \/ MEM x l2

name: MEM_APPEND_DECOMPOSE
display: |- forall x l. MEM x l <=> (exists l1 l2. l = APPEND l1 (CONS x l2))

name: MEM_APPEND_DECOMPOSE_LEFT
display:
|- forall x l.
       MEM x l <=> (exists l1 l2. ~MEM x l1 /\ l = APPEND l1 (CONS x l2))

name: MEM_ASSOC
display: |- forall l x. MEM (x,ASSOC x l) l <=> MEM x (MAP FST l)

name: MEM_EL
display: |- forall l n. n < LENGTH l ==> MEM (EL n l) l

name: MEM_EXISTS_EL
display: |- forall l x. MEM x l <=> (exists i. i < LENGTH l /\ x = EL i l)

name: MEM_FILTER
display: |- forall P l x. MEM x (FILTER P l) <=> P x /\ MEM x l

name: MEM_LIST_OF_SET
display: |- forall s. FINITE s ==> (forall x. MEM x (list_of_set s) <=> x IN s)

name: MEM_MAP
display: |- forall f y l. MEM y (MAP f l) <=> (exists x. MEM x l /\ y = f x)

name: MEM_REPLICATE
display: |- forall n x y. MEM x (REPLICATE n y) <=> x = y /\ ~(n = 0)

name: MIN
display: |- forall m n. MIN m n = (if m <= n then m else n)

name: MINIMAL
display:
|- forall P.
       (exists n. P n) <=>
       P ((minimal) P) /\ (forall m. m < (minimal) P ==> ~P m)

name: MINIMAL_BAD_SEQUENCE
display:
|- forall (<<) bad.
       WF (<<) /\
       (forall x.
            ~bad x
            ==> (exists n.
                     forall y. (forall k. k < n ==> y k = x k) ==> ~bad y)) /\
       (exists x. bad x)
       ==> (exists y.
                bad y /\
                (forall z n.
                     bad z /\ (forall k. k < n ==> z k = y k)
                     ==> ~(z n << y n)))

name: MINIMAL_LBOUND
display:
|- forall P n.
       (exists r. P r) /\ (forall m. m < n ==> ~P m) ==> n <= (minimal) P

name: MINIMAL_LE
display:
|- forall P n.
       (exists r. P r) ==> ((minimal) P <= n <=> (exists i. i <= n /\ P i))

name: MINIMAL_MONO
display:
|- forall P Q.
       (exists n. P n) /\ (forall n. P n ==> Q n)
       ==> (minimal) Q <= (minimal) P

name: MINIMAL_UBOUND
display: |- forall P n. P n ==> (minimal) P <= n

name: MINIMAL_UNIQUE
display: |- forall P n. P n /\ (forall m. m < n ==> ~P m) ==> (minimal) P = n

name: MK_REC_INJ
display: |- forall x y. _mk_rec x = _mk_rec y ==> ZRECSPACE x /\ ZRECSPACE y ==> x = y

name: MOD_0

name: MOD_1

name: MOD_2_CASES

name: MOD_ADD_CASES

       ==> (m + n) MOD p = (if m + n < p then m + n else (m + n) - p)

name: MOD_ADD_EQ
display: |- forall n x y. x MOD n + y MOD n < n ==> (x + y) MOD n = x MOD n + y MOD n

name: MOD_ADD_EQ_EQ
display:
|- forall n x y.
       (x + y) MOD n = x MOD n + y MOD n <=> n = 0 \/ x MOD n + y MOD n < n

name: MOD_ADD_MOD
display: |- forall a b n. (a MOD n + b MOD n) MOD n = (a + b) MOD n

name: MOD_CASES
display: |- forall n p. n < 2 * p ==> n MOD p = (if n < p then n else n - p)

name: MOD_DIV_EQ_0
display: |- forall m n. ~(n = 0) ==> (m MOD n) DIV n = 0

name: MOD_EQ
display: |- forall m n p q. m = n + q * p ==> m MOD p = n MOD p

name: MOD_EQ_0
display: |- forall m n. m MOD n = 0 <=> (exists q. m = q * n)

name: MOD_EQ_SELF

name: MOD_EVEN_2
display: |- forall m n. EVEN n ==> m MOD n MOD 2 = m MOD 2

name: MOD_EXISTS
display:
|- forall m n.
       (exists q. m = n * q) <=> (if n = 0 then m = 0 else m MOD n = 0)

name: MOD_EXP
display:
|- forall m n p.
       ~(m = 0)
       ==> m EXP n MOD m EXP p = (if p <= n \/ m = 1 then 0 else m EXP n)

name: MOD_EXP_MOD
display: |- forall m n p. (m MOD n) EXP p MOD n = m EXP p MOD n

name: MOD_LE
display: |- forall m n. m MOD n <= m

name: MOD_LE_TWICE
display: |- forall m n. 0 < m /\ m <= n ==> 2 * n MOD m <= n

name: MOD_LT
display: |- forall m n. m < n ==> m MOD n = m

name: MOD_LT_EQ
display: |- forall m n. m MOD n < n <=> ~(n = 0)

name: MOD_LT_EQ_LT

name: MOD_MOD
display: |- forall m n p. m MOD (n * p) MOD n = m MOD n

name: MOD_MOD_EXP_MIN
display: |- forall x p m n. x MOD p EXP m MOD p EXP n = x MOD p EXP MIN m n

name: MOD_MOD_LE
display: |- forall m n p. ~(n = 0) /\ n <= p ==> m MOD n MOD p = m MOD n

name: MOD_MOD_REFL
display: |- forall m n. m MOD n MOD n = m MOD n

name: MOD_MULT

name: MOD_MULT2
display: |- forall m n p. (m * n) MOD (m * p) = m * n MOD p

name: MOD_MULT_ADD
display:
|- (forall m n p. (m * n + p) MOD n = p MOD n) /\
   (forall m n p. (n * m + p) MOD n = p MOD n) /\
   (forall m n p. (p + m * n) MOD n = p MOD n) /\
   (forall m n p. (p + n * m) MOD n = p MOD n)

name: MOD_MULT_CONG
display: |- forall a b x y. (x MOD (a * b) == y) (mod a) <=> (x == y) (mod a)

name: MOD_MULT_LMOD
display: |- forall m n p. (m MOD n * p) MOD n = (m * p) MOD n

name: MOD_MULT_MOD
display: |- forall m n p. m MOD (n * p) = n * (m DIV n) MOD p + m MOD n

name: MOD_MULT_MOD2
display: |- forall m n p. (m MOD n * p MOD n) MOD n = (m * p) MOD n

name: MOD_MULT_RMOD
display: |- forall m n p. (m * p MOD n) MOD n = (m * p) MOD n

name: MOD_NSUM_MOD
display: |- forall f n s. FINITE s ==> nsum s f MOD n = nsum s (\i. f i MOD n) MOD n

name: MOD_NSUM_MOD_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f a b n. nsum (a..b) f MOD n = nsum (a..b) (\i. f i MOD n) MOD n

name: MOD_REFL
display: |- forall n. n MOD n = 0

name: MOD_UNIQ
display: |- forall m n q r. m = q * n + r /\ r < n ==> m MOD n = r

name: MOD_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall m n p.
       m MOD n = p <=> (n = 0 /\ m = p \/ p < n) /\ (m == p) (mod n)

name: MOD_ZERO
display: |- forall n. n MOD 0 = n

name: MONOIDAL_AC
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall a. op (neutral op) a = a) /\
           (forall a. op a (neutral op) = a) /\
           (forall a b. op a b = op b a) /\
           (forall a b c. op (op a b) c = op a (op b c)) /\
           (forall a b c. op a (op b c) = op b (op a c))

name: MONOIDAL_ADD
display: |- monoidal (+)

name: MONOIDAL_GCD

name: MONOIDAL_INT_ADD
display: |- monoidal (+)

name: MONO_ALL2
display: |- (forall x y. P x y ==> Q x y) ==> ALL2 P l l' ==> ALL2 Q l l'

name: MONO_COND

name: MONO_EXISTS

name: MONO_FORALL

name: MULT
display: |- (forall n. 0 * n = 0) /\ (forall m n. SUC m * n = m * n + n)

name: MULTIPLES_EQ
display: |- forall m n. m = n <=> (forall d. m divides d <=> n divides d)

name: MULT_0
display: |- forall m. m * 0 = 0

name: MULT_2
display: |- forall n. 2 * n = n + n

name: MULT_AC

name: MULT_ASSOC
display: |- forall m n p. m * n * p = (m * n) * p

name: MULT_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall n. 0 * n = 0) /\
   (forall m. m * 0 = 0) /\
   (forall n. 1 * n = n) /\
   (forall m. m * 1 = m) /\
   (forall m n. SUC m * n = m * n + n) /\
   (forall m n. m * SUC n = m + m * n)

name: MULT_DIV
display:
|- (forall m n p. p divides m ==> (m * n) DIV p = m DIV p * n) /\
   (forall m n p. p divides n ==> (m * n) DIV p = m * n DIV p)

name: MULT_DIV_LE
display: |- forall m n p. m * n DIV p <= (m * n) DIV p

name: MULT_EQ_0

name: MULT_EQ_1

name: MULT_EXP
display: |- forall p m n. (m * n) EXP p = m EXP p * n EXP p

name: MULT_GCD_LCM
display: |- forall m n. gcd (m,n) * lcm (m,n) = m * n

name: MULT_LCM_GCD
display: |- forall m n. lcm (m,n) * gcd (m,n) = m * n

name: MULT_SUC

name: MULT_SYM

name: NADD_ADDITIVE

name: NADD_ADD_ASSOC

name: NADD_ALTMUL

name: NADD_ARCH

name: NADD_ARCH_MULT

name: NADD_ARCH_ZERO

name: NADD_BOUND

name: NADD_CAUCHY
display:

name: NADD_COMPLETE
display:
|- forall P.
       (exists x. P x) /\ (exists M. forall x. P x ==> nadd_le x M)
       ==> (exists M.
                (forall x. P x ==> nadd_le x M) /\
                (forall M'.
                     (forall x. P x ==> nadd_le x M') ==> nadd_le M M'))

name: NADD_DIST
display:
|- forall x.

name: NADD_DIST_LEMMA
display:

name: NADD_EQ_IMP_LE

name: NADD_INV_WELLDEF

display: |- forall x y. nadd_le x (nadd_add x y)

name: NADD_LE_LADD
display: |- forall x y z. nadd_le (nadd_add x y) (nadd_add x z) <=> nadd_le y z

name: NADD_LE_LMUL
display: |- forall x y z. nadd_le y z ==> nadd_le (nadd_mul x y) (nadd_mul x z)

name: NADD_LE_RADD
display: |- forall x y z. nadd_le (nadd_add x z) (nadd_add y z) <=> nadd_le x y

name: NADD_LE_TRANS
display: |- forall x y z. nadd_le x y /\ nadd_le y z ==> nadd_le x z

name: NADD_LE_WELLDEF
display:

name: NADD_MUL_LINV
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA0
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists A B. forall n. nadd_rinv x n <= A * n + B)

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA1
display:
|- forall x n.
       ~(dest_nadd x n = 0)
       ==> dist (dest_nadd x n * nadd_rinv x n,n * n) <= dest_nadd x n

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA2
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists N.
                forall n.
                    N <= n
                    ==> dist (dest_nadd x n * nadd_rinv x n,n * n) <=

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA3
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists N.
                forall m n.
                    N <= n
                    ==> dist
                        (m * dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n * nadd_rinv x n,
                         m * dest_nadd x m * n * n) <=
                        m * dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n)

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA4
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists N.
                forall m n.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> (dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n) *
                        dist (m * nadd_rinv x n,n * nadd_rinv x m) <=
                        (m * n) * dist (m * dest_nadd x n,n * dest_nadd x m) +
                        (dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n) * (m + n))

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA5
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists B N.
                forall m n.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> (dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n) *

name: NSUM_RESTRICT_SET

|- forall P s f.
       nsum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f = nsum s (\x. if P x then f x else 0)

name: NSUM_RMUL
display: |- forall f c s. nsum s (\x. f x * c) = nsum s f * c

name: NSUM_SING
display: |- forall f x. nsum {x} f = f x

name: NSUM_SING_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f n. nsum (n..n) f = f n

name: NSUM_SUBSET
display:
|- forall u v f.
       FINITE u /\ FINITE v /\ (forall x. x IN u DIFF v ==> f x = 0)
       ==> nsum u f <= nsum v f

name: NSUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
display: |- forall u v f. FINITE v /\ u SUBSET v ==> nsum u f <= nsum v f

name: NSUM_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f u v.
       u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = 0)
       ==> nsum v f = nsum u f

name: NSUM_SUPPORT
display: |- forall f s. nsum (support (+) f s) f = nsum s f

name: NSUM_SWAP
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> nsum s (\i. nsum t (f i)) = nsum t (\j. nsum s (\i. f i j))

name: NSUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall a b c d f.
       nsum (a..b) (\i. nsum (c..d) (f i)) =
       nsum (c..d) (\j. nsum (a..b) (\i. f i j))

name: NSUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f m n. n < m ==> nsum (m..n) f = 0

name: NSUM_UNION
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ DISJOINT s t
       ==> nsum (s UNION t) f = nsum s f + nsum t f

name: NSUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall t. t IN s ==> FINITE t) /\
       (forall t1 t2 x.
            t1 IN s /\ t2 IN s /\ ~(t1 = t2) /\ x IN t1 /\ x IN t2
            ==> f x = 0)
       ==> nsum (UNIONS s) f = nsum s (\t. nsum t f)

name: NSUM_UNION_EQ
display:
|- forall s t u.
       FINITE u /\ s INTER t = {} /\ s UNION t = u
       ==> nsum s f + nsum t f = nsum u f

name: NSUM_UNION_LZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE v /\ (forall x. x IN u /\ ~(x IN v) ==> f x = 0)
       ==> nsum (u UNION v) f = nsum v f

name: NSUM_UNION_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ (forall x. x IN s INTER t ==> f x = 0)
       ==> nsum (s UNION t) f = nsum s f + nsum t f

name: NSUM_UNION_RZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE u /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = 0)
       ==> nsum (u UNION v) f = nsum u f

name: NSUM_UNIV
display: |- forall f s. support (+) f (:A) SUBSET s ==> nsum s f = nsum (:A) f

name: NULL
display: |- (NULL [] <=> true) /\ (NULL (CONS h t) <=> false)

name: NUMERAL
display: |- forall n. NUMERAL n = n

name: NUMPAIR
display: |- forall x y. NUMPAIR x y = 2 EXP x * (2 * y + 1)

name: NUMPAIR_DEST
display: |- forall x y. NUMFST (NUMPAIR x y) = x /\ NUMSND (NUMPAIR x y) = y

name: NUMPAIR_INJ
display: |- forall x1 y1 x2 y2. NUMPAIR x1 y1 = NUMPAIR x2 y2 <=> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2

name: NUMPAIR_INJ_LEMMA
display: |- forall x1 y1 x2 y2. NUMPAIR x1 y1 = NUMPAIR x2 y2 ==> x1 = x2

name: NUMSEG_ADD_SPLIT
display: |- forall m n p. m <= n + 1 ==> m..n + p = (m..n) UNION (n + 1..n + p)

name: NUMSEG_CARD_LE
display: |- forall s. 1..n <=_c s <=> FINITE s ==> n <= CARD s

name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall m. m..0 = (if m = 0 then {0} else {})) /\
   (forall m n.
        m..SUC n = (if m <= SUC n then SUC n INSERT (m..n) else m..n))

name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES_LE
display:
|- {i | i <= 0} = {0} /\
   (forall k. {i | i <= SUC k} = SUC k INSERT {i | i <= k})

name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES_LT
display: |- {i | i < 0} = {} /\ (forall k. {i | i < SUC k} = k INSERT {i | i < k})

name: NUMSEG_COMBINE_L
display: |- forall m p n. m <= p /\ p <= n + 1 ==> (m..p - 1) UNION (p..n) = m..n

name: NUMSEG_COMBINE_R
display: |- forall m p n. m <= p + 1 /\ p <= n ==> (m..p) UNION (p + 1..n) = m..n

name: NUMSEG_EMPTY
display: |- forall m n. m..n = {} <=> n < m

name: NUMSEG_LE
display: |- forall n. {x | x <= n} = 0..n

name: NUMSEG_LREC
display: |- forall m n. m <= n ==> m INSERT (m + 1..n) = m..n

name: NUMSEG_LT
display: |- forall n. {x | x < n} = (if n = 0 then {} else 0..n - 1)

name: NUMSEG_LT_DIMINDEX
display: |- {i | i < dimindex (:N)} = 0..dimindex (:N) - 1

name: NUMSEG_OFFSET_IMAGE
display: |- forall m n p. m + p..n + p = IMAGE (\i. i + p) (m..n)

name: NUMSEG_REC
display: |- forall m n. m <= SUC n ==> m..SUC n = SUC n INSERT (m..n)

name: NUMSEG_RREC
display: |- forall m n. m <= n ==> n INSERT (m..n - 1) = m..n

name: NUMSEG_SING
display: |- forall n. n..n = {n}

name: NUMSUM
display: |- forall b x. NUMSUM b x = (if b then SUC (2 * x) else 2 * x)

name: NUMSUM_DEST
display: |- forall x y. (NUMLEFT (NUMSUM x y) <=> x) /\ NUMRIGHT (NUMSUM x y) = y

name: NUMSUM_INJ
display: |- forall b1 x1 b2 x2. NUMSUM b1 x1 = NUMSUM b2 x2 <=> (b1 <=> b2) /\ x1 = x2

name: NUM_CASES_BINARY
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall n. P n) <=> (forall n. P (2 * n)) /\ (forall n. P (2 * n + 1))

name: NUM_COUNTABLE
display: |- COUNTABLE (:num)

name: NUM_GCD
display: |- forall a b. &(gcd (a,b)) = gcd (&a,&b)

name: NUM_LCM
display: |- forall a b. &(lcm (a,b)) = lcm (&a,&b)

name: NUM_OF_INT
display: |- forall x. &0 <= x <=> &(num_of_int x) = x

name: NUM_OF_INT_ADD
display:
|- forall x y.
       &0 <= x /\ &0 <= y
       ==> num_of_int (x + y) = num_of_int x + num_of_int y

name: NUM_OF_INT_MUL
display:
|- forall x y.
       &0 <= x /\ &0 <= y
       ==> num_of_int (x * y) = num_of_int x * num_of_int y

name: NUM_OF_INT_OF_NUM
display: |- forall n. num_of_int (&n) = n

name: NUM_OF_INT_POW
display: |- forall x n. &0 <= x ==> num_of_int (x pow n) = num_of_int x EXP n

name: NUM_REP_CASES
display:
|- forall a.
       NUM_REP a <=> a = IND_0 \/ (exists i. a = IND_SUC i /\ NUM_REP i)

name: NUM_REP_INDUCT
display:
|- forall NUM_REP'.
       NUM_REP' IND_0 /\ (forall i. NUM_REP' i ==> NUM_REP' (IND_SUC i))
       ==> (forall a. NUM_REP a ==> NUM_REP' a)

name: NUM_REP_RULES
display: |- NUM_REP IND_0 /\ (forall i. NUM_REP i ==> NUM_REP (IND_SUC i))

name: ODD
display: |- (ODD 0 <=> false) /\ (forall n. ODD (SUC n) <=> ~ODD n)

name: ODD_ADD
display: |- forall m n. ODD (m + n) <=> ~(ODD m <=> ODD n)

name: ODD_DOUBLE
display: |- forall n. ODD (SUC (2 * n))

name: ODD_EXISTS
display: |- forall n. ODD n <=> (exists m. n = SUC (2 * m))

name: ODD_EXP
display: |- forall m n. ODD (m EXP n) <=> ODD m \/ n = 0

name: ODD_MOD
display: |- forall n. ODD n <=> n MOD 2 = 1

name: ODD_MOD_EVEN
display: |- forall m n. EVEN n ==> (ODD (m MOD n) <=> ODD m)

name: ODD_MULT
display: |- forall m n. ODD (m * n) <=> ODD m /\ ODD n

name: ODD_PHI_EQ
display: |- forall n. ODD (phi n) <=> n = 1 \/ n = 2

name: ODD_PRIME
display: |- forall p. prime p ==> (ODD p <=> 3 <= p)

name: ODD_SUB
display: |- forall m n. ODD (m - n) <=> n < m /\ ~(ODD m <=> ODD n)

name: OEP
display:
|- forall p.
       poset p
       ==> (exists t.
                toset t /\ fld t = fld p /\ (forall x y. p x y ==> t x y))

name: ONE_ONE
display: |- forall f. ONE_ONE f <=> (forall x1 x2. f x1 = f x2 ==> x1 = x2)

name: ONE_OR_PRIME
display: |- forall p. p = 1 \/ prime p <=> (forall n. n divides p ==> n = 1 \/ n = p)

name: ONE_OR_PRIME_DIVIDES_OR_COPRIME
display: |- forall p. p = 1 \/ prime p <=> (forall n. p divides n \/ coprime (p,n))

name: ONTO
display: |- forall f. ONTO f <=> (forall y. exists x. y = f x)

name: ORDER
display: |- forall n a. (a EXP order n a == 1) (mod n)

name: ORDER_1
display: |- forall n. order n 1 = 1

name: ORDER_CONG
display: |- forall n a b. (a == b) (mod n) ==> order n a = order n b

name: ORDER_DIVIDES
display: |- forall n a d. (a EXP d == 1) (mod n) <=> order n a divides d

name: ORDER_DIVIDES_EXPDIFF
display:
|- forall a n d e.
       coprime (n,a)
       ==> ((a EXP d == a EXP e) (mod n) <=> (d == e) (mod order n a))

name: ORDER_DIVIDES_MAXIMAL
display:
|- forall p.
       ~(p = 1)
       ==> (exists n.
                coprime (p,n) /\
                (forall m. coprime (p,m) ==> order p m divides order p n))

name: ORDER_DIVIDES_PHI
display: |- forall a n. coprime (n,a) ==> order n a divides phi n

name: ORDER_EQ_0
display: |- forall n a. order n a = 0 <=> ~coprime (n,a)

name: ORDER_EQ_1
display: |- forall n a. order n a = 1 <=> (a == 1) (mod n)

name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_CARD
display:
|- forall R f z k.
       FINITE {R (ITER n f z) | n IN (:num)} /\
       CARD {R (ITER n f z) | n IN (:num)} <= k /\
       R z z /\
       (forall x y. R x y ==> R y x) /\
       (forall x y z. R x y /\ R y z ==> R x z) /\
       (forall x y. R (f x) (f y) <=> R x y)
       ==> (exists d.
                0 < d /\
                d <= k /\
                (forall n. R (ITER n f z) z <=> d divides n))

name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_FINITE
display:
|- forall R f z.
       FINITE {R (ITER n f z) | n IN (:num)} /\
       R z z /\
       (forall x y. R x y ==> R y x) /\
       (forall x y z. R x y /\ R y z ==> R x z) /\
       (forall x y. R (f x) (f y) <=> R x y)
       ==> (exists d. 0 < d /\ (forall n. R (ITER n f z) z <=> d divides n))

name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_GEN
display:
|- forall P f.
       P (f 0) /\
       (forall m n. P (f m) /\ ~(m = 0) ==> (P (f (m + n)) <=> P (f n)))
       ==> (exists d. forall n. P (f n) <=> d divides n)

name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_ITER
display:
|- forall R f z.
       R z z /\
       (forall x y. R x y ==> R y x) /\
       (forall x y z. R x y /\ R y z ==> R x z) /\
       (forall x y. R x y ==> R (f x) (f y))
       ==> (exists d. forall n. R (ITER n f z) z <=> d divides n)

name: ORDER_EXP
display:
|- forall p a k.
       ~(k = 0) /\ k divides order p a
       ==> order p (a EXP k) = order p a DIV k

name: ORDER_EXP_GEN
display:
|- forall p a k.
       order p (a EXP k) =
       (if k = 0 then 1 else order p a DIV gcd (order p a,k))

name: ORDER_INVERSE_MOD
display: |- forall n a. coprime (n,a) ==> order n (inverse_mod n a) = order n a

name: ORDER_LCM_EXISTS
display: |- forall p a b. exists c. order p c = lcm (order p a,order p b)

name: ORDER_LE_PHI
display: |- forall n. ~(n = 0) ==> order n a <= phi n

name: ORDER_MINIMAL
display: |- forall n a m. 0 < m /\ m < order n a ==> ~(a EXP m == 1) (mod n)

name: ORDER_MOD
display: |- forall p n. order p (n MOD p) = order p n

name: ORDER_MUL_DIVIDES
display: |- forall p a b. order p (a * b) divides order p a * order p b

name: ORDER_MUL_EQ
display:
|- forall p a b.
       coprime (order p a,order p b)
       ==> order p (a * b) = order p a * order p b

name: ORDER_MUL_LCM
display:
|- forall m n a.
       coprime (m,n) ==> order (m * n) a = lcm (order m a,order n a)

name: ORDER_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall n a k.
       0 < k /\
       (a EXP k == 1) (mod n) /\
       (forall m. 0 < m /\ m < k ==> ~(a EXP m == 1) (mod n))
       ==> order n a = k

name: ORDER_UNIQUE_ALT
display:
|- forall n a d.
       order n a = d <=> (forall k. (a EXP k == 1) (mod n) <=> d divides k)

name: ORDER_UNIQUE_PRIME
display:
|- forall n a p.
       prime p
       ==> (order n a = p <=> ~(a == 1) (mod n) /\ (a EXP p == 1) (mod n))

name: ORDER_WORKS
display:
|- forall n a.
       (a EXP order n a == 1) (mod n) /\
       (forall m. 0 < m /\ m < order n a ==> ~(a EXP m == 1) (mod n))

name: ORDINAL_CHAINED
display: |- forall l m. ordinal l /\ ordinal m ==> m inseg l \/ l inseg m

name: ORDINAL_CHAINED_LEMMA
display:
|- forall k l m.
       ordinal l /\ ordinal m
       ==> k inseg l /\ k inseg m
       ==> k = l \/
           k = m \/
           (exists a. fld l a /\ fld m a /\ k = linseg l a /\ k = linseg m a)

name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET
display: |- forall l m. ordinal l /\ ordinal m /\ fld l SUBSET fld m ==> l inseg m

name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET_EQ
display: |- forall l m. ordinal l /\ ordinal m ==> (fld l SUBSET fld m <=> l inseg m)

name: ORDINAL_FLD_UNIQUE
display: |- forall l m. ordinal l /\ ordinal m /\ fld l = fld m ==> l = m

name: ORDINAL_IMP_WOSET
display: |- forall l. ordinal l ==> woset l

name: ORDINAL_SUC
display:
|- forall l.
       ordinal l /\ (exists x. ~fld l x)
       ==> ordinal
           (\x y.
                l x y \/
                y = (@y. ~fld l y) /\ (fld l x \/ x = (@y. ~fld l y)))

name: ORDINAL_UNION
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall l. P l ==> ordinal l)
       ==> ordinal (\x y. exists l. P l /\ l x y)

name: ORDINAL_UNION_LEMMA
display:
|- forall l x.
       ordinal l ==> fld l x ==> fld (\a b. exists l. ordinal l /\ l a b) x

name: ORDINAL_UP
display:
|- forall l.
       ordinal l
       ==> (forall x. fld l x) \/
           (exists m x. ordinal m /\ fld m x /\ ~fld l x)

name: OR_CLAUSES
display:
|- forall t.
       (true \/ t <=> true) /\
       (t \/ true <=> true) /\
       (false \/ t <=> t) /\
       (t \/ false <=> t) /\
       (t \/ t <=> t)

name: OR_EXISTS_THM
display: |- forall P Q. (exists x. P x) \/ (exists x. Q x) <=> (exists x. P x \/ Q x)

name: OUTL
display: |- OUTL (INL x) = x

name: OUTR
display: |- OUTR (INR y) = y

name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
display:
|- forall p x e.
       &0 < e /\ &1 < p
       ==> (exists n q r.
                integer q /\
                integer r /\
                q / p pow n < x /\
                x < r / p pow n /\
                abs (q / p pow n - r / p pow n) < e)

name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS
display:
|- forall p x e.
       &0 < e /\ &1 < p /\ &0 < x
       ==> (exists n q r.
                &q / p pow n < x /\
                x < &r / p pow n /\
                abs (&q / p pow n - &r / p pow n) < e)

name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS_LE
display:
|- forall p x e.
       &0 < e /\ &1 < p /\ &0 <= x
       ==> (exists n q r.
                &q / p pow n <= x /\
                x < &r / p pow n /\
                abs (&q / p pow n - &r / p pow n) < e)

name: PAIR
display: |- forall x. FST x,SND x = x

name: PAIRED_ETA_THM
display:
|- (forall f. (\(x,y). f (x,y)) = f) /\
   (forall f. (\(x,y,z). f (x,y,z)) = f) /\
   (forall f. (\(w,x,y,z). f (w,x,y,z)) = f)

name: PAIRED_EXT
display: |- forall l m. (forall x y. l x y = m x y) <=> l = m

name: PAIRWISE
display:
|- (PAIRWISE r [] <=> true) /\
   (PAIRWISE r (CONS h t) <=> ALL (r h) t /\ PAIRWISE r t)

name: PAIRWISE_AND
display:
|- forall R R' s.
       pairwise R s /\ pairwise R' s <=> pairwise (\x y. R x y /\ R' x y) s

name: PAIRWISE_APPEND
display:
|- forall R l m.
       PAIRWISE R (APPEND l m) <=>
       PAIRWISE R l /\
       PAIRWISE R m /\
       (forall x y. MEM x l /\ MEM y m ==> R x y)

name: PAIRWISE_CHAIN_UNIONS
display:
|- forall R c.
       (forall s. s IN c ==> pairwise R s) /\
       (forall s t. s IN c /\ t IN c ==> s SUBSET t \/ t SUBSET s)
       ==> pairwise R (UNIONS c)

name: PAIRWISE_EMPTY
display: |- forall r. pairwise r {} <=> true

name: PAIRWISE_IMAGE
display:
|- forall r f.
       pairwise r (IMAGE f s) <=>
       pairwise (\x y. ~(f x = f y) ==> r (f x) (f y)) s

name: PAIRWISE_IMP
display:
|- forall P Q s.
       pairwise P s /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ P x y /\ ~(x = y) ==> Q x y)
       ==> pairwise Q s

name: PAIRWISE_IMPLIES
display:
|- forall R R' l.
       PAIRWISE R l /\ (forall x y. MEM x l /\ MEM y l /\ R x y ==> R' x y)
       ==> PAIRWISE R' l

name: PAIRWISE_INSERT
display:
|- forall r x s.
       pairwise r (x INSERT s) <=>
       (forall y. y IN s /\ ~(y = x) ==> r x y /\ r y x) /\ pairwise r s

name: PAIRWISE_INSERT_SYMMETRIC
display:
|- forall r x s.
       (forall y. y IN s ==> (r x y <=> r y x))
       ==> (pairwise r (x INSERT s) <=>
            (forall y. y IN s /\ ~(y = x) ==> r x y) /\ pairwise r s)

name: PAIRWISE_MAP
display: |- forall R f l. PAIRWISE R (MAP f l) <=> PAIRWISE (\x y. R (f x) (f y)) l

name: PAIRWISE_MONO
display: |- forall r s t. pairwise r s /\ t SUBSET s ==> pairwise r t

name: PAIRWISE_SING
display: |- forall r x. pairwise r {x} <=> true

name: PAIRWISE_TRANSITIVE
display:
|- forall R x y l.
       (forall x y z. R x y /\ R y z ==> R x z)
       ==> (PAIRWISE R (CONS x (CONS y l)) <=>
            R x y /\ PAIRWISE R (CONS y l))

name: PAIRWISE_UNION
display:
|- forall R s t.
       pairwise R (s UNION t) <=>
       pairwise R s /\
       pairwise R t /\
       (forall x y. x IN s DIFF t /\ y IN t DIFF s ==> R x y /\ R y x)

name: PAIR_EQ
display: |- forall x y a b. x,y = a,b <=> x = a /\ y = b

name: PAIR_EXISTS_THM
display: |- exists x a b. x = mk_pair a b

name: PAIR_SURJECTIVE
display: |- forall p. exists x y. p = x,y

name: PASSOC_DEF
display: |- forall f x y z. PASSOC f (x,y,z) = f ((x,y),z)

name: PASTECART_COMPONENT
display:
|- (forall u v i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:M) ==> pastecart u v$i = u$i) /\
   (forall u v i.
        dimindex (:M) + 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:M) + dimindex (:N)
        ==> pastecart u v$i = v$(i - dimindex (:M)))

name: PASTECART_EQ
display: |- forall x y. x = y <=> fstcart x = fstcart y /\ sndcart x = sndcart y

name: PASTECART_FST_SND
display: |- forall z. pastecart (fstcart z) (sndcart z) = z

name: PASTECART_INJ
display: |- forall x y w z. pastecart x y = pastecart w z <=> x = w /\ y = z

name: PASTECART_IN_PCROSS
display: |- forall s t x y. pastecart x y IN s PCROSS t <=> x IN s /\ y IN t

name: PCROSS
display: |- forall s t. s PCROSS t = {pastecart x y | x IN s /\ y IN t}

name: PCROSS_DIFF
display:
|- (forall s t u. s PCROSS (t DIFF u) = s PCROSS t DIFF s PCROSS u) /\
   (forall s t u. (s DIFF t) PCROSS u = s PCROSS u DIFF t PCROSS u)

name: PCROSS_EMPTY
display: |- (forall s. s PCROSS {} = {}) /\ (forall t. {} PCROSS t = {})

name: PCROSS_EQ
display:
|- forall s s' t t'.
       s PCROSS t = s' PCROSS t' <=>
       (s = {} \/ t = {}) /\ (s' = {} \/ t' = {}) \/ s = s' /\ t = t'

name: PCROSS_EQ_EMPTY
display: |- forall s t. s PCROSS t = {} <=> s = {} \/ t = {}

name: PCROSS_INTER
display:
|- (forall s t u. s PCROSS (t INTER u) = s PCROSS t INTER s PCROSS u) /\
   (forall s t u. (s INTER t) PCROSS u = s PCROSS u INTER t PCROSS u)

name: PCROSS_INTERS
display:
|- (forall s f.
        s PCROSS INTERS f =
        (if f = {} then s PCROSS (:A^N) else INTERS {s PCROSS t | t IN f})) /\
   (forall f t.
        INTERS f PCROSS t =
        (if f = {} then (:A^M) PCROSS t else INTERS {s PCROSS t | s IN f}))

name: PCROSS_INTERS_INTERS
PCROSS_MONO
display:
|- forall s t s' t'.

name: POCKLINGTON
display:
|- forall a n q r.
       2 <= n /\
       n - 1 = q * r /\
       n <= q EXP 2 /\
       (a EXP (n - 1) == 1) (mod n) /\
       (forall p.
            prime p /\ p divides q ==> coprime (a EXP ((n - 1) DIV p) - 1,n))
       ==> prime n

name: POCKLINGTON_ALT
display:
|- forall a n q r.
       2 <= n /\
       n - 1 = q * r /\
       n <= q EXP 2 /\
       (a EXP (n - 1) == 1) (mod n) /\
       (forall p.
            prime p /\ p divides q
            ==> (exists b.
                     (a EXP ((n - 1) DIV p) == b) (mod n) /\
                     coprime (b - 1,n)))
       ==> prime n

name: POCKLINGTON_LEMMA
display:
|- forall a n q r.
       2 <= n /\
       n - 1 = q * r /\
       (a EXP (n - 1) == 1) (mod n) /\
       (forall p.
            prime p /\ p divides q ==> coprime (a EXP ((n - 1) DIV p) - 1,n))
       ==> (forall p. prime p /\ p divides n ==> (p == 1) (mod q))

name: POCKLINGTON_PRIMEFACT
display:
|- 2 <= n /\ q * r = n - 1 /\ n <= q * q
   ==> a EXP r MOD n = b
   ==> ITLIST (*) ps 1 = q
   ==> b EXP q MOD n = 1
   ==> ALL (\p. prime p /\ coprime (b EXP (q DIV p) MOD n - 1,n)) ps
   ==> prime n

display: |- forall s. s SUBSET {} <=> s = {}

name: SUBSET_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f s t.
       s SUBSET IMAGE f t <=> (exists u. u SUBSET t /\ s = IMAGE f u)

name: SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
display:
|- forall f s t.
       s SUBSET IMAGE f t <=>
       (exists u.
            u SUBSET t /\
            (forall x y. x IN u /\ y IN u ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y)) /\
            s = IMAGE f u)

name: SUBSET_INSERT
display: |- forall x s. ~(x IN s) ==> (forall t. s SUBSET x INSERT t <=> s SUBSET t)

name: SUBSET_INSERT_DELETE
display: |- forall x s t. s SUBSET x INSERT t <=> s DELETE x SUBSET t

name: SUBSET_INTER
display: |- forall s t u. s SUBSET t INTER u <=> s SUBSET t /\ s SUBSET u

name: SUBSET_INTERS
display: |- forall s f. s SUBSET INTERS f <=> (forall t. t IN f ==> s SUBSET t)

name: SUBSET_INTER_ABSORPTION
display: |- forall s t. s SUBSET t <=> s INTER t = s

name: SUBSET_NUMSEG
display: |- forall m n p q. m..n SUBSET p..q <=> n < m \/ p <= m /\ n <= q

name: SUBSET_PCROSS
display:
|- forall s t s' t'.
       s PCROSS t SUBSET s' PCROSS t' <=>
       s = {} \/ t = {} \/ s SUBSET s' /\ t SUBSET t'

name: SUBSET_PSUBSET_TRANS
display: |- forall s t u. s SUBSET t /\ t PSUBSET u ==> s PSUBSET u

name: SUBSET_REFL
display: |- forall s. s SUBSET s

name: SUBSET_RESTRICT
display: |- forall s P. {x | x IN s /\ P x} SUBSET s

name: SUBSET_TRANS
display: |- forall s t u. s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET u ==> s SUBSET u

name: SUBSET_UNION
display: |- (forall s t. s SUBSET s UNION t) /\ (forall s t. s SUBSET t UNION s)

name: SUBSET_UNIONS
display: |- forall f g. f SUBSET g ==> UNIONS f SUBSET UNIONS g

name: SUBSET_UNION_ABSORPTION
display: |- forall s t. s SUBSET t <=> s UNION t = t

name: SUBSET_UNIV
display: |- forall s. s SUBSET (:A)

name: SUBWOSET_ISO_INSEG
display:
|- forall l s.
       woset l /\ fld l = (:A)
       ==> (exists f.
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> (l (f x) (f y) <=> l x y)) /\
                (forall x y. y IN IMAGE f s /\ l x y ==> x IN IMAGE f s))

name: SUB_0
display: |- forall m. 0 - m = 0 /\ m - 0 = m

name: SUB_ADD
display: |- forall m n. n <= m ==> m - n + n = m

name: SUB_ADD_LCANCEL
display: |- forall m n p. (m + n) - (m + p) = n - p

name: SUB_ADD_RCANCEL
display: |- forall m n p. (m + p) - (n + p) = m - n

name: SUB_ELIM_THM
display: |- P (a - b) <=> (forall d. a = b + d \/ a < b /\ d = 0 ==> P d)

name: SUB_ELIM_THM'
display: |- P (a - b) <=> (exists d. (a = b + d \/ a < b /\ d = 0) /\ P d)

name: SUB_EQ_0
display: |- forall m n. m - n = 0 <=> m <= n

name: SUB_PRESUC
display: |- forall m n. PRE (SUC m - n) = m - n

name: SUB_REFL
display: |- forall n. n - n = 0

name: SUB_SUC
display: |- forall m n. SUC m - SUC n = m - n

name: SUC_DEF
display: |- forall n. SUC n = mk_num (IND_SUC (dest_num n))

name: SUC_INJ
display: |- forall m n. SUC m = SUC n <=> m = n

name: SUC_SUB1
display: |- forall n. SUC n - 1 = n

name: SUM_0
display: |- forall s. sum s (\n. &0) = &0

name: SUM_ABS
display: |- forall f s. FINITE s ==> abs (sum s f) <= sum s (\x. abs (f x))

name: SUM_ABS_BOUND
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> abs (f x) <= b)
       ==> abs (sum s f) <= &(CARD s) * b

name: SUM_ABS_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> abs (f x) <= g x)
       ==> abs (sum s f) <= sum s g

name: SUM_ABS_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f m n. abs (sum (m..n) f) <= sum (m..n) (\i. abs (f i))

name: SUM_ADD
display: |- forall f g s. FINITE s ==> sum s (\x. f x + g x) = sum s f + sum s g

name: SUM_ADD_GEN
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE {x | x IN s /\ ~(f x = &0)} /\
       FINITE {x | x IN s /\ ~(g x = &0)}
       ==> sum s (\x. f x + g x) = sum s f + sum s g

name: SUM_ADD_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f g m n. sum (m..n) (\i. f i + g i) = sum (m..n) f + sum (m..n) g

name: SUM_ADD_SPLIT
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       m <= n + 1 ==> sum (m..n + p) f = sum (m..n) f + sum (n + 1..n + p) f

name: SUM_BIJECTION
display:
|- forall f p s.
       (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
       (forall y. y IN s ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ p x = y))
       ==> sum s f = sum s (f o p)

name: SUM_BOUND
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b)
       ==> sum s f <= &(CARD s) * b

name: SUM_BOUND_GEN
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b / &(CARD s))
       ==> sum s f <= b

name: SUM_BOUND_LT
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ f x < b)
       ==> sum s f < &(CARD s) * b

name: SUM_BOUND_LT_ALL
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x < b)
       ==> sum s f < &(CARD s) * b

name: SUM_BOUND_LT_GEN
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x < b / &(CARD s))
       ==> sum s f < b

name: SUM_CASES
display:
|- forall s P f g.
       FINITE s
       ==> sum s (\x. if P x then f x else g x) =
           sum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f + sum {x | x IN s /\ ~P x} g

name: SUM_CASES_1
display:
|- forall s a.
       FINITE s /\ a IN s
       ==> sum s (\x. if x = a then y else f x) = sum s f + y - f a

name: SUM_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall f. sum {} f = &0) /\
   (forall x f s.
        FINITE s
        ==> sum (x INSERT s) f = (if x IN s then sum s f else f x + sum s f))

name: SUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> sum (m..n) f = f m + sum (m + 1..n) f

name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
display:
|- (forall m. sum (m..0) f = (if m = 0 then f 0 else &0)) /\
   (forall m n.
        sum (m..SUC n) f =
        (if m <= SUC n then sum (m..n) f + f (SUC n) else sum (m..n) f))

name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
display:
|- sum {i | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\
   (forall k. sum {i | i <= SUC k} f = sum {i | i <= k} f + f (SUC k))

name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
display:
|- sum {i | i < 0} f = &0 /\
   (forall k. sum {i | i < SUC k} f = sum {i | i < k} f + f k)

name: SUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
display: |- forall f m n. 0 < n /\ m <= n ==> sum (m..n) f = sum (m..n - 1) f + f n

name: SUM_CLOSED
display:
|- forall P f s.
       P (&0) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (sum s f)

name: SUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall P f s.
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (sum s f)

name: SUM_COMBINE_L
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       0 < n /\ m <= n /\ n <= p + 1
       ==> sum (m..n - 1) f + sum (n..p) f = sum (m..p) f

name: SUM_COMBINE_R
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p
       ==> sum (m..n) f + sum (n + 1..p) f = sum (m..p) f

name: SUM_CONST
display: |- forall c s. FINITE s ==> sum s (\n. c) = &(CARD s) * c

name: SUM_CONST_NUMSEG
display: |- forall c m n. sum (m..n) (\n. c) = &((n + 1) - m) * c

name: SUM_DEGENERATE
display: |- forall f s. ~FINITE {x | x IN s /\ ~(f x = &0)} ==> sum s f = &0

name: SUM_DELETE
display: |- forall f s a. FINITE s /\ a IN s ==> sum (s DELETE a) f = sum s f - f a

name: SUM_DELETE_CASES
display:
|- forall f s a.
       FINITE s
       ==> sum (s DELETE a) f = (if a IN s then sum s f - f a else sum s f)

name: SUM_DELTA
display:
|- forall s a.
       sum s (\x. if x = a then b else &0) = (if a IN s then b else &0)

name: SUM_DIFF
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ t SUBSET s ==> sum (s DIFF t) f = sum s f - sum t f

name: SUM_DIFFS
display:
|- forall m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f k - f (k + 1)) =
       (if m <= n then f m - f (n + 1) else &0)

name: SUM_DIFFS_ALT
display:
|- forall m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f (k + 1) - f k) =
       (if m <= n then f (n + 1) - f m else &0)

name: SUM_EQ
display: |- forall f g s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x) ==> sum s f = sum s g

name: SUM_EQ_0
display: |- forall f s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = &0) ==> sum s f = &0

name: SUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = &0) ==> sum (m..n) f = &0

name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL
display:
|- forall s t f g h.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ h x = y)) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ g (h x) = f x)
       ==> sum s f = sum t g

name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
display:
|- forall s t f g h k.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> k y IN s /\ h (k y) = y) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)
       ==> sum s f = sum t g

name: SUM_EQ_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = g i)
       ==> sum (m..n) f = sum (m..n) g

name: SUM_EQ_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE t /\
       t SUBSET s /\
       (forall x. x IN t ==> f x = g x) /\
       (forall x. x IN s /\ ~(x IN t) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum s f = sum t g

name: SUM_GROUP
display:
|- forall f g s t.
       FINITE s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t
       ==> sum t (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g) = sum s g

name: SUM_GROUP_RELATION
display:
|- forall R g s t.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> (existsunique y. y IN t /\ R x y))
       ==> sum t (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ R x y} g) = sum s g

name: SUM_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> sum (IMAGE f s) g = sum s (g o f)

name: SUM_IMAGE_GEN
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s
       ==> sum s g = sum (IMAGE f s) (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g)

name: SUM_IMAGE_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= g (f x))
       ==> sum (IMAGE f s) g <= sum s (g o f)

name: SUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
display:
|- forall d i s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x y.
            x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) /\ i x = i y ==> d (i x) = &0)
       ==> sum (IMAGE i s) d = sum s (d o i)

name: SUM_INCL_EXCL
display:
|- forall s t f.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> sum s f + sum t f = sum (s UNION t) f + sum (s INTER t) f

name: SUM_INJECTION
display:
|- forall f p s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ p x = p y ==> x = y)
       ==> sum s (f o p) = sum s f

name: SUM_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) ==> sum s f <= sum s g

name: SUM_LE_INCLUDED
display:
|- forall f g s t i.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall y. y IN t ==> &0 <= g y) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> (exists y. y IN t /\ i y = x /\ f x <= g y))
       ==> sum s f <= sum t g

name: SUM_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i <= g i)
       ==> sum (m..n) f <= sum (m..n) g

name: SUM_LMUL
display: |- forall f c s. sum s (\x. c * f x) = c * sum s f

name: SUM_LT
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ f x < g x)
       ==> sum s f < sum s g

name: SUM_LT_ALL
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x < g x)
       ==> sum s f < sum s g

name: SUM_MULTICOUNT
display:
|- forall R s t k.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall j. j IN t ==> CARD {i | i IN s /\ R i j} = k)
       ==> sum s (\i. &(CARD {j | j IN t /\ R i j})) = &(k * CARD t)

name: SUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
display:
|- forall R s t k.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall j. j IN t ==> CARD {i | i IN s /\ R i j} = k j)
       ==> sum s (\i. &(CARD {j | j IN t /\ R i j})) = sum t (\i. &(k i))

name: SUM_MUL_BOUND
display:
|- forall a b s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> &0 <= a i /\ &0 <= b i)
       ==> sum s (\i. a i * b i) <= sum s a * sum s b

name: SUM_NEG
display: |- forall f s. sum s (\x. --f x) = --sum s f

name: SUM_OFFSET
display: |- forall p f m n. sum (m + p..n + p) f = sum (m..n) (\i. f (i + p))

name: SUM_OFFSET_0
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> sum (m..n) f = sum (0..n - m) (\i. f (i + m))

name: SUM_PAIR
display:
|- forall f m n.
       sum (2 * m..2 * n + 1) f = sum (m..n) (\i. f (2 * i) + f (2 * i + 1))

name: SUM_PARTIAL_PRE
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f k * (g k - g (k - 1))) =
       (if m <= n
        then f (n + 1) * g n -
             f m * g (m - 1) -
             sum (m..n) (\k. g k * (f (k + 1) - f k))
        else &0)

name: SUM_PARTIAL_SUC
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f k * (g (k + 1) - g k)) =
       (if m <= n
        then f (n + 1) * g (n + 1) -
             f m * g m -
             sum (m..n) (\k. g (k + 1) * (f (k + 1) - f k))
        else &0)

name: SUM_POS_BOUND
display:
|- forall f b s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\ sum s f <= b
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b)

name: SUM_POS_EQ_0
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\ sum s f = &0
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = &0)

name: SUM_POS_EQ_0_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> &0 <= f p) /\ sum (m..n) f = &0
       ==> (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> f p = &0)

name: SUM_POS_LE
display: |- forall s. (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) ==> &0 <= sum s f

name: SUM_POS_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall m n f.
       (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> &0 <= f p) ==> &0 <= sum (m..n) f

name: SUM_POS_LT
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ &0 < f x)
       ==> &0 < sum s f

name: SUM_POS_LT_ALL
display:
|- forall s f.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> &0 < f i)
       ==> &0 < sum s f

name: SUM_REFLECT
display:
|- forall x m n.
       sum (m..n) x = (if n < m then &0 else sum (0..n - m) (\i. x (n - i)))

name: SUM_RELATED
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       R (&0) (&0) /\
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m + m') (n + n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
       ==> R (sum s f) (sum s g)

name: SUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m + m') (n + n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
       ==> R (sum s f) (sum s g)

name: SUM_RESTRICT
display: |- forall f s. FINITE s ==> sum s (\x. if x IN s then f x else &0) = sum s f

name: SUM_RESTRICT_SET
display:
|- forall P s f.
       sum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f = sum s (\x. if P x then f x else &0)

name: SUM_RMUL
display: |- forall f c s. sum s (\x. f x * c) = sum s f * c

name: SUM_SING
display: |- forall f x. sum {x} f = f x

name: SUM_SING_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f n. sum (n..n) f = f n

name: SUM_SPLIT_2
display: |- sum (1..2 * n) f = sum (1..n) f + sum (n + 1..2 * n) f

name: SUM_SUB
display: |- forall f g s. FINITE s ==> sum s (\x. f x - g x) = sum s f - sum s g

name: SUM_SUBSET
display:
|- forall u v f.
       FINITE u /\
       FINITE v /\
       (forall x. x IN u DIFF v ==> f x <= &0) /\
       (forall x. x IN v DIFF u ==> &0 <= f x)
       ==> sum u f <= sum v f

name: SUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
display:
|- forall u v f.
       FINITE v /\ u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v DIFF u ==> &0 <= f x)
       ==> sum u f <= sum v f

name: SUM_SUB_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f g m n. sum (m..n) (\i. f i - g i) = sum (m..n) f - sum (m..n) g

name: SUM_SUM_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall s t x.
       FINITE s /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> FINITE (t i))
       ==> sum s (\i. sum (t i) (x i)) =
           sum {i,j | i IN s /\ j IN t i} (\(i,j). x i j)

name: SUM_SUM_RESTRICT
display:
|- forall R f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> sum s (\x. sum {y | y IN t /\ R x y} (\y. f x y)) =
           sum t (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ R x y} (\x. f x y))

name: SUM_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f u v.
       u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum v f = sum u f

name: SUM_SUPPORT
display: |- forall f s. sum (support (+) f s) f = sum s f

name: SUM_SWAP
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> sum s (\i. sum t (f i)) = sum t (\j. sum s (\i. f i j))

name: SUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall a b c d f.
       sum (a..b) (\i. sum (c..d) (f i)) =
       sum (c..d) (\j. sum (a..b) (\i. f i j))

name: SUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f m n. n < m ==> sum (m..n) f = &0

name: SUM_UNION
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ DISJOINT s t
       ==> sum (s UNION t) f = sum s f + sum t f

name: SUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall t. t IN s ==> FINITE t) /\
       (forall t1 t2 x.
            t1 IN s /\ t2 IN s /\ ~(t1 = t2) /\ x IN t1 /\ x IN t2
            ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (UNIONS s) f = sum s (\t. sum t f)

name: SUM_UNION_EQ
display:
|- forall s t u.
       FINITE u /\ s INTER t = {} /\ s UNION t = u
       ==> sum s f + sum t f = sum u f

name: SUM_UNION_LZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE v /\ (forall x. x IN u /\ ~(x IN v) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (u UNION v) f = sum v f

name: SUM_UNION_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ (forall x. x IN s INTER t ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (s UNION t) f = sum s f + sum t f

name: SUM_UNION_RZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE u /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (u UNION v) f = sum u f

name: SUM_UNIV
display: |- forall f s. support (+) f (:A) SUBSET s ==> sum s f = sum (:A) f

name: SUM_ZERO_EXISTS
display:
|- forall u s.
       FINITE s /\ sum s u = &0
       ==> (forall i. i IN s ==> u i = &0) \/
           (exists j k. j IN s /\ u j < &0 /\ k IN s /\ u k > &0)

name: SUP
display:
|- forall s.
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b)
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= sup s) /\
           (forall b. (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) ==> sup s <= b)

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_COND
display:
|- forall (<<) p P s h k.
       admissible (<<) p s P /\
       superadmissible (<<) (\f x. p f x /\ P f x) s h /\
       superadmissible (<<) (\f x. p f x /\ ~P f x) s k
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s (\f x. if P f x then h f x else k f x)

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_MATCH_GUARDED_PATTERN
display:
|- forall (<<) p s e pat q arg.
       (forall f a t u.
            p f a /\ pat t = e a /\ q a t /\ pat u = e a /\ q a u
            ==> arg a t = arg a u) /\
       (forall f a t.
            p f a /\ q a t /\ pat t = e a
            ==> (forall y. y << arg a t ==> y << s a))
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s
           (\f x. match e x with pat t when q x t -> f (arg x t))

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_MATCH_UNGUARDED_PATTERN
display:
|- forall (<<) p s e pat arg.
       (forall f a t u.
            p f a /\ pat t = e a /\ pat u = e a ==> arg a t = arg a u) /\
       (forall f a t.
            p f a /\ pat t = e a ==> (forall y. y << arg a t ==> y << s a))
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s
           (\f x. match e x with pat t -> f (arg x t))

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_TAIL
display:
|- forall (<<) p s t.
       admissible (<<) p s t /\
       (forall f a. p f a ==> (forall y. y << t f a ==> y << s a))
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s (\f x. f (t f x))

name: SUPPORT_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall f. support op f {} = {}) /\
   (forall f x s.
        support op f (x INSERT s) =
        (if f x = neutral op then support op f s else x INSERT support op f s)) /\
   (forall f x s. support op f (s DELETE x) = support op f s DELETE x) /\
   (forall f s t.
        support op f (s UNION t) = support op f s UNION support op f t) /\
   (forall f s t.
        support op f (s INTER t) = support op f s INTER support op f t) /\
   (forall f s t.
        support op f (s DIFF t) = support op f s DIFF support op f t) /\
   (forall f g s. support op g (IMAGE f s) = IMAGE f (support op (g o f) s))

name: SUPPORT_DELTA
display:
|- forall op s f a.
       support op (\x. if x = a then f x else neutral op) s =
       (if a IN s then support op f {a} else {})

name: SUPPORT_EMPTY
display:
|- forall op f s.
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = neutral op) <=> support op f s = {}

name: SUPPORT_SUBSET
display: |- forall op f s. support op f s SUBSET s

name: SUPPORT_SUPPORT
display: |- forall op f s. support op f (support op f s) = support op f s

name: SUP_APPROACH
display:
|- forall s c.
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) /\ c < sup s
       ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ c < x)

name: SUP_EQ
display:
|- forall s t.
       (forall b.
            (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) <=> (forall x. x IN t ==> x <= b))
       ==> sup s = sup t

name: SUP_EXISTS
display:
|- forall s.
       (exists l. s has_sup l) <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b)

name: SUP_FINITE
display:
|- forall s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})
       ==> sup s IN s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= sup s)

name: SUP_FINITE_LEMMA
display:

       ==> (exists b. b IN s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b))

name: SUP_INSERT_FINITE
display:
|- forall x s.

name: SUP_INSERT_INSERT
display: |- forall a b s. sup (b INSERT a INSERT s) = sup (max a b INSERT s)

name: SUP_SING
display: |- forall a. sup {a} = a

name: SUP_UNION
display:
|- forall s t.
       ~(s = {}) /\
       ~(t = {}) /\
       (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) /\
       (exists c. forall x. x IN t ==> x <= c)
       ==> sup (s UNION t) = max (sup s) (sup t)

name: SUP_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall s b.
       (forall c. (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= c) <=> b <= c) ==> sup s = b

name: SUP_UNIQUE_FINITE
display:

       ==> (sup s = a <=> a IN s /\ (forall y. y IN s ==> y <= a))

name: SURJ
display:

       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\
       (forall x. x IN t ==> (exists y. y IN s /\ f y = x))

name: SURJECTIVE_EXISTS_THM
display:

       (forall P. (exists x. P (f x)) <=> (exists y. P y))

name: SURJECTIVE_FORALL_THM

name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE

       ==> ((forall y. y IN s ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ f x = y)) <=>
            (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y))

name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE_GEN
display:
|- forall s t f.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ CARD s = CARD t /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t
       ==> ((forall y. y IN t ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ f x = y)) <=>
            (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y))

name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE

name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE_EQ

display:

name: SURJECTIVE_MAP

name: SURJECTIVE_ON_IMAGE

       (forall t. t SUBSET v ==> (exists s. s SUBSET u /\ IMAGE f s = t)) <=>
       (forall y. y IN v ==> (exists x. x IN u /\ f x = y))

name: SURJECTIVE_ON_PREIMAGE

       (forall k.
            k SUBSET s
            ==> (exists t. t SUBSET u /\ {x | x IN s /\ f x IN t} = k)) <=>
       IMAGE f s SUBSET u /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)

name: SURJECTIVE_ON_RIGHT_INVERSE
display:
|- forall f t.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ f x = y)) <=>
       (exists g. forall y. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y)

name: SURJECTIVE_PREIMAGE
display:

name: SURJECTIVE_RIGHT_INVERSE

name: TOPOLOGICAL_SORT
display:
|- forall (<<).
       (forall x y. x << y /\ y << x ==> x = y) /\
       (forall x y z. x << y /\ y << z ==> x << z)
       ==> (forall n s.
                s HAS_SIZE n
                ==> (exists f.
                         s = IMAGE f (1..n) /\
                         (forall j k.
                              j IN 1..n /\ k IN 1..n /\ j < k
                              ==> ~(f k << f j))))

name: WF_REC_CASES

       WF (<<) /\
       ALL
       (\(s,t).
            exists P G H.
                (forall f a y. P f a /\ y << G f a ==> y << s a) /\
                (forall f g a.
                     (forall z. z << s a ==> f z = g z)
                     ==> (P f a <=> P g a) /\ G f a = G g a /\ H f a = H g a) /\
                (forall f a. t f a = (if P f a then f (G f a) else H f a)))
       clauses
       ==> (exists f. forall x. f x = CASEWISE clauses f x)

            ==> (exists f. forall x. P f x (f x)))

            ==> (exists f. forall x. f x = H f x))

       (forall f g x. (forall z. z << x ==> f z = g z) ==> H f x = H g x) /\
       (forall f x y. P f x /\ y << G f x ==> y << x)

name: iterato

|- forall dom neut op (<<=) k f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f =
       (if FINITE {i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
           ~({i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} = {})
        then let i =
                 (if exists i.
                         i IN k /\
                         f i IN dom DIFF {neut} /\
                         (forall j.
                              j <<= i /\ j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}
                              ==> j = i)
                  then @i.
                           i IN k /\
                           f i IN dom DIFF {neut} /\
                           (forall j.
                                j <<= i /\ j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}
                                ==> j = i)
                  else @i. i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}) in
             op (f i)
             (iterato dom neut op (<<=)
              {j | j IN k DELETE i /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}}
             f)
        else neut)

name: sndcart
display: |- forall f. sndcart f = (lambda i. f$(i + dimindex (:M)))

name: sqrt
display: |- forall x. sqrt x = (@y. real_sgn y = real_sgn x /\ y pow 2 = abs x)

name: squarefree
display: |- forall n. squarefree n <=> (forall m. m EXP 2 divides n ==> m = 1)

name: strictly
display: |- forall R. strictly R = (\x y. R x y /\ ~R y x)

name: string_INFINITE
display: |- INFINITE (:(char)list)

name: sum
display: |- sum = iterate (+)

name: sum_CASES
display: |- forall x. (exists a. x = INL a) \/ (exists a. x = INR a)

name: sum_DISTINCT
display: |- forall a a'. ~(INL a = INR a')

name: sum_INDUCT
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall a. P (INL a)) /\ (forall a. P (INR a)) ==> (forall x. P x)

name: sum_INJECTIVE
display:
|- (forall a a'. INL a = INL a' <=> a = a') /\
   (forall a a'. INR a = INR a' <=> a = a')

name: sum_RECURSION
display:
|- forall INL' INR'.
       exists fn.
           (forall a. fn (INL a) = INL' a) /\ (forall a. fn (INR a) = INR' a)

name: sup
display:
|- forall s.
       sup s =
       (@a.
            (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= a) /\
            (forall b. (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) ==> a <= b))

name: support
display: |- forall s f op. support op f s = {x | x IN s /\ ~(f x = neutral op)}

name: tailadmissible
display:
|- forall (<<) s p t.
       tailadmissible (<<) p s t <=>
       (exists P G H.
            (forall f a y. P f a /\ y << G f a ==> y << s a) /\
            (forall f g a.
                 (forall z. z << s a ==> f z = g z)
                 ==> (P f a <=> P g a) /\ G f a = G g a /\ H f a = H g a) /\
            (forall f a.
                 p f a ==> t f a = (if P f a then f (G f a) else H f a)))

name: toset
display:
|- forall l.
       toset l <=>
       (forall x. x IN fld l ==> l x x) /\
       (forall x y z. l x y /\ l y z ==> l x z) /\
       (forall x y. l x y /\ l y x ==> x = y) /\
       (forall x y. x IN fld l /\ y IN fld l ==> l x y \/ l y x)

name: treal_add
display:
|- forall x1 x2 y1 y2.
       (x1,y1) treal_add (x2,y2) = hreal_add x1 x2,hreal_add y1 y2

name: treal_eq
display:
|- forall x1 y2 x2 y1.
       x1,y1 treal_eq x2,y2 <=> hreal_add x1 y2 = hreal_add x2 y1

name: treal_inv
display:
|- forall y x.
       treal_inv (x,y) =
       (if x = y
        then & 0,& 0
        else if hreal_le y x
             then hreal_inv (@d. x = hreal_add y d),& 0
             else & 0,hreal_inv (@d. y = hreal_add x d))

name: treal_le
display:
|- forall x1 y2 x2 y1.
       x1,y1 treal_le x2,y2 <=> hreal_le (hreal_add x1 y2) (hreal_add x2 y1)

name: treal_mul
display:
|- forall x1 y2 y1 x2.
       (x1,y1) treal_mul (x2,y2) =
       hreal_add (hreal_mul x1 x2) (hreal_mul y1 y2),
       hreal_add (hreal_mul x1 y2) (hreal_mul y1 x2)

name: treal_neg
display: |- forall y x. treal_neg (x,y) = y,x

name: treal_of_num
display: |- forall n. treal_of_num n = & n,& 0

name: tybit0_INDUCT
display: |- forall P. (forall a. P (mktybit0 a)) ==> (forall x. P x)

name: tybit0_RECURSION
display: |- forall f. exists fn. forall a. fn (mktybit0 a) = f a

name: tybit1_INDUCT
display: |- forall P. (forall a. P (mktybit1 a)) ==> (forall x. P x)

name: tybit1_RECURSION
display: |- forall f. exists fn. forall a. fn (mktybit1 a) = f a

name: vector
display: |- forall l. vector l = (lambda i. EL (i - 1) l)

name: woset
display:
|- forall l.
       woset l <=>
       (forall x. x IN fld l ==> l x x) /\
       (forall x y z. l x y /\ l y z ==> l x z) /\
       (forall x y. l x y /\ l y x ==> x = y) /\
       (forall x y. x IN fld l /\ y IN fld l ==> l x y \/ l y x) /\
       (forall s.
            s SUBSET fld l /\ ~(s = {})
            ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ (forall y. y IN s ==> l x y)))

name: wqoset
display:
|- forall l.
       wqoset l <=>
       (forall x. x IN fld l ==> l x x) /\
       (forall x y z. l x y /\ l y z ==> l x z) /\
       (forall s.
            s SUBSET fld l
            ==> (exists t.
                     FINITE t /\
                     t SUBSET s /\
                     (forall y. y IN s ==> (exists x. x IN t /\ l x y))))
